Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Spain.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping business strategy through advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven insights. You will investigate the factors influencing customer acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention, helping teams make smarter decisions and accelerate sustainable growth. Working at the intersection of Data Science, Product, and Growth, you will turn complex business questions into actionable recommendations with measurable impact. You will own analytical projects end to end, from working with raw data and building reliable data models to applying statistical methods and communicating findings. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, you will challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and influence strategic priorities. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial thinking, and analytical ownership within a collaborative, international, and innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities


Lead business-critical investigations across the customer journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels to evaluate investment effectiveness and identify growth opportunities.
Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests in collaboration with Product and Growth teams, applying statistical analysis, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods where traditional experimentation is not feasible.
Build, test, document, and maintain reliable, production-ready data models using SQL, Python, and data transformation tools, ensuring the quality and integrity of analytical foundations.
Go beyond descriptive reporting to explain business performance, identify underlying drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.
Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior, developing analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify and act on opportunities faster.
Partner with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and senior leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable results.
Take ownership of analytical projects from initial problem definition and data preparation through modeling, interpretation, stakeholder communication, and implementation of recommendations.


Requirements


Significant experience in applied Data Science or advanced analytics, ideally within a SaaS, digital product, product-led growth, or marketing-driven business, with a proven ability to influence business decisions.
Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience designing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining reliable data models. Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools is highly valued.
Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.
Solid knowledge of statistics, experimentation, and causal inference, including experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and selecting appropriate methods for complex analytical questions.
Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with a strong understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience analyzing SEO or paid search performance is a plus.
Strong product and commercial acumen, with the ability to connect metrics to business outcomes, prioritize high-value questions, and identify opportunities for improvement.
An end-to-end ownership mindset, with the ability to manage the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data and modeling to interpretation, communication, and actionable recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, enabling you to explain complex analytical findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A curious, proactive, and independent approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions, explore unfamiliar problems, and go beyond the initial request.
Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international working environment.


Nice To Have


Experience in subscription-based or product-led growth businesses, particularly in conversion optimization, pricing, retention, or customer lifetime value.
Hands-on experience with marketing incrementality, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or quasi-experimental techniques.
Experience developing analytical frameworks or data products that are adopted and used by business teams.
Previous experience in a lean, high-impact Data team, independently owning both analytical projects and the underlying data models.
A proven track record of influencing Product, Growth, or Marketing strategy through rigorous analysis and clear, evidence-based recommendations.


Benefits


Meaningful business impact: Contribute to a global digital product used by more than 60 million people every month, with your analyses directly informing business performance and growth.
Autonomy and ownership: Take responsibility for complex analytical challenges from start to finish and see your recommendations translate into real business decisions.
Collaborative environment: Work closely with experienced Data, Product, and Growth leaders in a team that values curiosity, knowledge sharing, and thoughtful decision-making.
Remote flexibility: Enjoy a remote working environment across supported European locations, with a hybrid option for team members based in Zurich.
Generous annual leave: Benefit from 30 vacation days each year.
Sabbatical leave: Access extended leave after more than two years with the company.
Parental support: Receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave at 100% of salary for all new parents.
Professional development: Access an annual personal development budget of up to CHF 2,000, plus time off for courses and training.
Continuous learning: Benefit from internal knowledge-sharing sessions and external coaching opportunities during working hours to strengthen technical and interpersonal skills.
Innovation opportunities: Participate in dedicated hack days to experiment, collaborate, and develop new ideas.
International exposure: Work with a diverse, global team in an established digital product environment that combines scale with the agility of a lean organization.


How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Data Scientist, Parameta Solutions (Madrid)
Description:
Role Overview

We are on a mission to harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to shape the next generation of financial intelligence solutions. As we continue to expand our Data Science capability, we are seeking a talented and innovative Data Scientist to develop cutting-edge analytical and Generative AI solutions that drive commercial value across our business.




Based in Madrid and working within Parameta Solutions, you will play a key role in designing, developing and deploying scalable data products that transform complex financial data into actionable insights. Working closely with Data Engineering, Product, Commercial and Technology teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, cloud technologies and Generative AI capabilities to support the evolution of our data-driven product suite.




This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly growing function at the forefront of financial data innovation, helping to shape the future of analytics, intelligence and AI-powered solutions across the organisation.




Role Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain robust Python-based applications for financial data analysis, transformation, enrichment and automation.
Build scalable data science solutions that extract actionable insights from large and complex financial datasets.
Develop interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks and visualisation tools to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Enhance, support and continuously improve existing data applications, data quality frameworks and analytical platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers and commercial stakeholders to ensure the scalability, reliability and usability of data products and models.
Apply software engineering best practices, including modular development, code reviews, automated testing, version control and CI/CD methodologies.
Design, develop and maintain Generative AI solutions that enhance internal processes, analytical capabilities and customer-facing products.
Leverage AWS cloud technologies and services to build scalable AI and machine learning applications, making full use of innovative capabilities available through our strategic AWS partnership.
Evaluate emerging AI, machine learning and data science technologies, identifying opportunities to improve products, processes and client outcomes.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Parameta Solutions' data science and AI capabilities, helping establish best practices and technical standards across the team.




Experience / Competences

Essential

Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications within a data science, machine learning or quantitative analytics environment.
Demonstrated software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented programming, modular design patterns and version control.
Experience building and deploying analytical, machine learning or AI-driven solutions in a commercial environment.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying and manipulating large-scale datasets.
Experience working with modern data and engineering platforms such as Snowflake, Airflow, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

Demonstrated understanding of cloud-based architectures and services, particularly within AWS environments.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Industry experience in a computational or quantitative data science role.
Experience developing customer-facing analytics, recommendation engines or AI-powered products.

Experience working within agile product and engineering environments.
Passion for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Data Scientist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This role sits within our Data Science team and partners closely with our In Silico Discovery (ISD) organization - the group that builds the molecular design and property-prediction models (for example, developability, affinity and binding, and other molecular-property and liability-risk models) that guide which biologic molecules to design, make, and advance. ISD owns core molecular model development; you will build the data-facing ML capabilities (featurization, model-ready datasets) that make ISD's models faster to build and better to trust.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-095854

Spain - Requisition Number: R-096793

Why this role matters: Biologics Discovery is generating rich, fast-growing data across assays, sequences, and modalities, and the opportunity now is to make that data fully model-ready and seamlessly available for ML. This role ensures biologics data is structured for training, and that applied ML on discovery data helps scientists prioritize molecules, flag risks, and generate hypotheses earlier - strengthening the interface to ISD's models rather than duplicating them.

Position Summary

You will design robust featurization approaches and curate standardized, traceable, model-ready datasets from biologics assay, biophysical, sequence, and construct data. You operate at the interface between our data-generating and data-infrastructure partners and In Silico Discovery (ISD), ensuring the datasets and features you create strengthen ISD's molecular property models. This is an opportunity to shape how AI learns from every biologics experiment.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Data Analysis & Enablement


Apply modern data science tools to explore, integrate, and characterize heterogeneous biologics discovery data (e.g., antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data).
Work with discovery scientists to translate scientific questions and DMTL (design-make-test-learn) decision points into clear data and analytical requirements.
Identify data quality issues, biases, gaps, and risks such as leakage or distribution shift that could affect downstream modeling or scientific interpretation.
Support the effective use of data for molecule prioritization, risk identification, and hypothesis generation.


Featurization & Model-Ready Data


Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from biologics discovery data.
Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.
Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.


Partnership, Rigor & Growth


Collaborate with ISD to hand off standardized, traceable training datasets and align on where Data Science enables versus where ISD owns modeling.
Partner with Discovery scientists to frame ML problems around real decision points in the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.
Work closely with ontology and MLOps colleagues so datasets carry consistent semantics and models move reliably from development into use.
Champion reproducibility, documentation, and responsible AI.


Why This Role Is Unique

This is an opportunity to apply ML where it truly moves the needle in biologics discovery - grounded in real assay and sequence data, tightly partnered with world-class molecular modeling, and with real room to grow your scope, technical leadership, and impact as you build a track record of delivery.

Qualifications

Required


Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, or a related field.
At least 2 years of applied ML experience, including model development, evaluation, and dataset curation on complex scientific or biomedical data.
Strong proficiency with Python and the modern ML stack (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn) and SQL.
Experience turning complex, heterogeneous experimental data into robust features and training sets, with exposure to cloud training and data infrastructure.
Sound understanding of evaluation, validation, and the risks of leakage and distribution shift.
Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental scientists and modeling partners in a matrixed R&D environment.


Preferred


Experience with biologics, antibody/protein sequence models, or protein language models.
Experience with active learning, Bayesian optimization, or sequence-based generative models for molecular design.
Familiarity with biophysical/assay data and developability endpoints.
Experience with MLOps, experiment tracking, and model monitoring.
Familiarity with how ontologies or knowledge graphs support data reuse and AI-ready datasets.


This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Title: Data Scientist - AI/ML (Remote)
Description:
Role: Data Scientist - AI/ML (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Data Scientist (ML) to work on a Full-Time basis. The role involves developing and deploying machine learning models to improve predictive accuracy for client datasets. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify data-driven solutions and automate workflows.




Key Responsibilities:

• Design, train, and optimize machine learning models for classification, regression, and clustering tasks.

• Preprocess and analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to extract actionable insights.

• Implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for model deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

• Develop and document reproducible experiments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, and version control systems.

• Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders through clear visualizations and technical reports.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

• Experience with SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

• Strong background in statistical modeling and experimental design.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure for model deployment.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development industry, contributing to the scalability of AI-driven solutions. You will gain exposure to cutting-edge tools and collaborate with experts in data science and engineering.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
Nuestro objetivo es ayudar a todos los recién graduados del mundo a encontrar el trabajo que más se ajuste a sus ambiciones: ¡únete a nosotros para hacer realidad las aspiraciones de una comunidad de más de 1,500,000 usuarios!




Observamos constantemente los recursos de los estudiantes y egresados que aspiran a incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Tecnología: los candidatos para este puesto y nuestro equipo de RRHH se pondrán en contacto contigo sin comunicar puesto y tu CV será el adecuado a tu perfil.




Para estas posiciones junior en el sector Tech, ofrecemos un contrato con una remuneración anual de 24.000€ a 28.000 €, dependiendo de la experiencia. Podrás trabajar en modalidad completamente remota y, por ello, te proporcionaremos en cualquier momento un MacBook de última generación.




¡Nos vamos a España! Si quieres sumarte a crecer en tu país, envía tu CV para este anuncio: si tu perfil está en alguno de nuestros futuros puestos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo ;)

--




Dentro del equipo de Tecnología podrás abordar diversas tareas como:




Implementación de algoritmos de Machine Learning: tendrá la oportunidad de implementar y probar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático, ayudando a desarrollar soluciones inteligentes a los desafíos comerciales. En particular, junto con nuestro equipo tecnológico, trabajarás en Joinrs AI: nuestro modelo de Inteligencia Artificial que ayuda a nuestra comunidad a encontrar trabajo;
Análisis y modelado de datos: participará en el análisis de datos, desarrollará modelos predictivos y ayudará a proporcionar información significativa para mejorar las decisiones comerciales.
Visualización de datos: aprenderá a crear visualizaciones de datos claras e informativas para comunicar de manera efectiva hallazgos complejos a diferentes partes interesadas. En particular, creará paneles interactivos para mostrar mejor los datos y KPI (visualización de datos) al equipo, los clientes, los inversores y todas las partes interesadas clave;
Optimización de Procesos de Negocio: Colaborarás en la identificación y optimización de procesos de negocio mediante la aplicación de soluciones basadas en datos.
Participación en Sesiones de Brainstorming Tecnológico: Participarás en sesiones de Brainstorming para generar ideas innovadoras y contribuirás a la identificación de nuevas oportunidades en el campo de la Inteligencia Artificial.
Formación Continua y Actualización en las Últimas Tendencias: Tendrás acceso a programas de formación continua para mantenerte actualizado sobre las últimas tendencias y avances en el campo de la Ciencia de Datos y la Inteligencia Artificial.

--




Lo que te ofrecemos

Trabajar en el equipo de Joinrs significa poder elegir siempre las mejores condiciones psicofísicas para estar sereno y productivo. Esto se traduce en:




Trabajo remoto y flexibilidad. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar completamente a distancia todo el tiempo que desees, pero también apoyarte en una de nuestras oficinas.
Ambiente de trabajo dinámico. Nuestras oficinas siempre están abiertas. Te garantizamos espacios de trabajo compartidos, salas de reuniones, áreas de descanso y un bar con frutas frescas y aperitivos de todo tipo. También encontrarás una mesa de billar y una estación de juegos. Queremos un ambiente de trabajo informal que fomente momentos de compartir, siempre respetando las actividades individuales.
Team building y diversión. Organizamos a menudo aperitivos, juegos y momentos de recreo: son parte integral de la vida en Joinrs, tanto fuera como dentro de la oficina.
Bienestar empresarial. Te garantizamos un bienestar empresarial privado a la altura de tus expectativas.
Paquete tecnológico. Utilizarás software avanzado y tecnologías modernas, y se te proporcionará un MacBook de última generación.
Formación. Siempre contarás con un tutor en tu trayectoria en Joinrs: tendrás un punto de referencia tanto para los aspectos técnicos como para los del equipo. Te aseguramos un crecimiento profesional constante que se traducirá en un aumento progresivo de tus responsabilidades. Podrás participar en eventos del sector y cursos de formación, además de recibir formación continua en las mejores plataformas de aprendizaje en línea.
Impacto social. Tu contribución apoyará a miles de recién graduados a encontrar el trabajo al que aspiran: tendrás la oportunidad de interactuar con nuestra comunidad y descubrir el impacto social y la revolución que estamos llevando más allá de las fronteras italianas.

--




Quiénes somos

Nuestra misión es apoyar a cada recién graduado a lograr sus aspiraciones, permitiéndole comenzar su nueva carrera con el optimismo de una perspectiva clara.




Somos un equipo unido que cree firmemente en el trabajo en equipo: juntos trabajamos, discutimos y obtenemos resultados que nos estimulan a alcanzar objetivos cada vez más ambiciosos.




Nuestra comunidad cuenta con más de 1,500,000 miembros en Italia, Reino Unido, España, Brasil, Francia, Portugal y Alemania, incluyendo 700 empresas como PwC, Accenture, Gi Group, Danone, Siemens, y está creciendo de manera exponencial: ¡únete a nosotros!

--




Contrato y Remuneración:

Para todos los puestos de Junior Data Scientist ofrecemos un contrato con un salari anualo de €24,000 a €28.000.




Se programará una revisión salarial cada seis meses, y tu remuneración crecerá rápidamente a medida que acumules experiencia y la traduzcas en un impacto cada vez mayor.

--




Proceso de selección:

1. Revisión del CV: el primer paso es una revisión del currículum (generalmente dentro de los 20 días posteriores a la solicitud).

2. Entrevista telefónica: el segundo paso incluirá una entrevista telefónica con nuestro Gerente de Recursos Humanos de aproximadamente 15 minutos.

3. Entrevista por video: el último paso será una entrevista por video con tanto el Gerente de Recursos Humanos como tu futuro supervisor. Prevemos al menos 45 minutos de entrevista.

--




¿Por qué unirte a nuestro equipo?

Impacto social: tendrás la oportunidad de apoyar a nuestra comunidad para que logren sus aspiraciones. Y las tuyas.

Startup exitosa: Joinrs fue seleccionada entre las 10 mejores startups del mundo en la Web Summit de Lisboa.

Crecimiento personal exponencial: tendrás la oportunidad de crecer de manera exponencial, tanto en habilidades técnicas como en habilidades blandas, gracias a un programa de formación basado en la capacitación en el trabajo y el apoyo en línea.

¡Nos vamos a España! Si quieres sumarte a crecer en tu país, envía tu CV para este anuncio: si tu perfil está en alguno de nuestros futuros puestos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo ;)

Para todos los puestos de Junior Data Scientist ofrecemos un contrato con un salari anualo de €24,000 a €28.000.

Impacto social: tendrás la oportunidad de apoyar a nuestra comunidad para que logren sus aspiraciones. Y las tuyas.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
OGC is a boutique market research and data analysis consulting firm specializing in customer experience analytics, innovation testing, and data visualization. We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our team.




Our mission is to help our clients become more insightful, create happier end customers, and uncover opportunities to grow their businesses. We employ a hands-on approach to research and consulting: we follow a comprehensive discovery process, apply advanced analysis techniques using state-of-the-art tools, draw conclusions collaboratively in cross-functional teams, and utilize workshops to foster action.




Our client portfolio is international, with a focus on US-based, Fortune 500 companies, across a variety of industries such as Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software.




This position follows East Coast (ET) hours.




The ideal candidate for this position is a bright, independent, detail-oriented individual, with a strong analytical background, who is passionate about using data to help customers drive strategic decisions and business improvements. They are a methodological problem solver who is driven by curiosity to find answers to challenging puzzles. We are looking for a candidate who loves working with people, has an excellent business acumen, and who is always eager to learn. Our data scientists are self-starters, with a strong technical background and a deep familiarity with data analysis and quantitative research methodologies.




In this role, you will work directly with our clients and deliver consulting projects to senior stakeholders, with the end goal of leveraging data to help our clients drive strategic decisions and business improvements. This position provides an excellent opportunity to apply your strong analytical background to the Market Research and Customer Experience domain while working directly with global, Fortune 500 companies.




Responsibilities include

Support the execution of quantitative research and consulting projects from start to finish including project planning, data analysis, modeling, and building insights-based reports
Work with other data scientists, designers, and project managers on interdisciplinary projects using your skillset to derive structure and knowledge from raw data across various industry sectors
Work on complex and varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems
Develop data science products and solutions for clients, as well as for our internal team
Client Communication and engagement including building and delivering insights-based reports
Build, deploy and automate various algorithms (classification, regression, forecasting) and support the production of automated reports and analysis
Transform large volumes of data from internal and external sources in a manner suitable for analysis
Research new data sources, analytical tools, and methodologies for data science and data engineering
Perform complex data analysis in support of ad-hoc and standing requests, focusing on delivering key insights
Provide an expert point of view on analytical techniques and guidance to our analysts and sales directors




Requirements

Bachelor’s degree from a top university
MA/MS in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or other quantitative field - An advantage
4+ years of professional experience as a project-oriented data analyst or scientist
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze issues, identify causes, and recommend solutions quickly
Strong quantitative background with a high comfort level for learning new technologies
Diverse technical skills including:
Python (High Level)
Modeling/Machine Learning
Statistics
SQL
Excel (VBA, Power Pivot, Power Query, DAX - An advantage)
Data Visualization (Tableau, PowerBI - An advantage)
Demonstrated experience with common Python packages for data analysis and modeling; including Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Jupyter, Dask, PySpark, etc. - An advantage
Expertise in one or more specific data science domains (geospatial analytics, dashboards, text analytics, causal inference, cloud computing, etc.) - An advantage
Must speak and write English fluently and idiomatically

Title: Data Scientist - Analytics Business Consulting
Description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

As a Data Scientist in our EU Analytics practice, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.

You will play a pivotal role in building advanced analytical models and methodologies, integrating Veeva Data Cloud products with complex European healthcare data assets. You will drive innovation across our analytical offerings, ensuring Veeva remains at the forefront of data-led, tech-enabled Life Sciences commercial models. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to bridge technical modeling with practical business insights across European markets. You will take ownership of any of our analytics assets (e.g., design solution, manage expectations, status accountancy, impact measurement).

What You'll Do


Design, prototype, and scale advanced analytics solutions for Life Sciences customers across European markets
Process, harmonize, and connect Veeva Data Cloud products with diverse European healthcare data assets
Develop and apply statistical methodologies, machine learning, and AI models to solve complex, high-impact commercial and strategic business questions in the Life Sciences space
Build and design HCP precision engagement engines that connect disparate healthcare datasets integrated seamlessly with customer CRM information to enable personalized, data-driven targeting and activation
Collaborate closely in integrated, cross-functional teams alongside product managers, data engineers, operations, and consultants to deliver end-to-end analytical solutions and ensure continuous feedback and iteration
Maintain clear documentation of data methodologies, model architectures, and validation processes to ensure defensibility, scalability, and transparency across client engagements


Requirements


2+ years of proven experience in data science, advanced analytics, or machine learning roles, preferably within Life Sciences, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare analytics
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams. Skilled at translating complex technical challenges to non-technical stakeholders, driving impactful problem-solving sessions, and championing a pragmatic approach to solution design
Strong technical expertise across Python, SQL, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI, with a proven ability to design and implement predictive models and intelligent algorithms that solve complex business problems
You bring Experience writing process documentation, technical specifications, and data collection guidelines to ensure quality, scalability, and repeatability across projects


Nice to Have


Knowledge of Veeva products
Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions
M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Languages in addition to English
Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines) and automation tools such as Apache Airflow
Familiarity with cloud based computing resources such as AWS


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva
Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day


Compensation


Total compensation: 48,000 - 75,000 EUR

Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Commodity Trading and Risk Management
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, mental health, and vision coverage for you, your spouse/partner, and children.


Your Impact

You will leverage your creativity and problem-solving skills to tackle clients’ most pressing issues using an analytical lens, meeting client needs and communicating your work to executive audiences.

Client counterparts span a wide range of audiences and functions from treasury and risk professionals, marketing & sales teams, procurement category managers, to high-level stakeholders (e.g., CFO). When working internally, you will build innovative algorithms and products (what we call “IP development”) to best meet our most common client needs, from building price forecasting models for commodities markets, to brainstorming and developing new offers and solutions to support future clients. You will also work with our engineers to design new interfaces to deliver faster, more impactful insights to our clients.

Your work on the team will primarily be in applying advanced analytics to enable better commodity risk management decisions. For example, you might work as the lead in maintaining and expanding existing hedging strategies by re-training existing models through process driven approaches. You might also modify and improve algorithm performance across market regimes, by introducing new features, data sources, and modelling approaches; rapidly identify opportunities for our clients to increase earnings potential and reduce downside risk by back testing various risk management strategies; co-build bespoke tools with client data science teams that tailor machine-learning algorithms to attain an optimal balance of earnings and volatility given clients’ risk appetite and capital constraints; and/or collaborate with and train cross-functional client teams to instill long-lasting capabilities and ensure new decision-making models are embraced by organizations.

You will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior commodity and risk practitioners, as well as industry players that are shaping the future of commodity markets and trading. You will get access to unparalleled career acceleration, with a huge amount of ownership and responsibility from the get-go in a collaborative, diverse, non-hierarchical environment. You will get the opportunity to travel to client sites, locally and around the world (once travel resumes). Lastly, you will be able to provide direct and measurable impact to some of the largest organizations in agribusiness, materials, energy, industrial, and consumer foods sectors around the globe.

As a member of the Commodity Analytics team, you will be based in one of the following offices: Brussels, Amsterdam, Madrid or Lisbon. You’ll work closely with McKinsey’s Commodity Trading Service Line to support clients across sectors and geographies.

Commodity Analytics helps commodity producers, processors, buyers, and traders across agriculture/softs, metals, energy, and consumer sectors improve commodity price risk capabilities with cutting-edge data science.

The Commodity Trading Service Line at McKinsey supports clients in commodity trading and risk strategy, trading operations transformation, and trading and risk digitization driven by deep trading experts with hands-on trading experience and advanced analytics assets.

Our Risk Practice supports clients in many different industries facing challenges of developing and implementing tailored concepts for risk.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Required:


Undergraduate degree
Production-quality Python for model development, including optimization, time series forecasting, feature engineering, backtesting, and evaluation using standard DS toolkits (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, gradient boosting, etc.)
Familiarity with pytest and reproducible research workflow; experience operationalizing models: versioned experiments, CI/CD, model monitoring and drift detection, and collaboration with engineering on APIs and model/solution design
Experience applying advanced analytical and statistical methods to solve business problems involving commodity markets
Ability to explain commodity market nuances and/or complex analytics approaches and results in layman’s terms to executive audiences across commodity trading, operations, supply chain / logistics, and finance / accounting functions


Preferred experience (all not expected):


Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline (computer science, applied mathematics, economics, quantitative finance, engineering) or equivalent practitioner experience
2+ years’ experience in commodity markets developing market research, trading, or hedging/risk management strategies such as netback/deal economics, signal backtesting, stress testing, and/or hedge effectivenes
2+ years’ experience in physical/cash markets of metals, power/electricity markets, natural gas, crude oil, refined products, and/or ocean freight
2+ years’ experience applying time series analysis of mean-reverting and cointegrated commodity prices/premiums (e.g., ARIMA, VECM, GARCH), supervised learning (e.g., SVM, LSTM, parallel or sequential tree-based models), unsupervised learning (e.g., PCA, K-means clustering), optimization (e.g., LP/MILP and stochastic models), and/or NLP sentiment analysis
6+ months’ experience with LLM-based analytics in enterprise settings (e.g., document/comms extraction, RAG, evaluation/guardrails)
Experience integrating data science and/or automation workflows with CTRM/ETRM systems via API
Experience automating middle/back-office processes with PRA and LLMs (e.g., pre-trade KYC/credit, trade execution, compliance, logistics, trade settlement)

Scalian es una empresa de más de 6.000 personas, con dimensión internacional y oficinas en Europa y América del Norte. Diseñar y desarrollar sistemas multiagente y soluciones basadas en LLMs para distintos casos de uso.
Construir pipelines de datos orientados a aplicaciones de IA Generativa.
Implementar arquitecturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) y workflows agentic, incluyendo tool calling y planificación de agentes.

Garantizar la calidad, seguridad y gobernanza de las soluciones, gestionando riesgos como sesgos, alucinaciones y privacidad.

Experiencia con patrones RAG, búsqueda híbrida, re-ranking y recuperación contextual.

Experiencia trabajando en entornos AWS.

Title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Spain - BCG X
Description:
Locations: Madrid | Madrid

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

Our Forward Deployed AI Scientist and Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist are part of our rapidly growing team to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, creative, and communicative.

We Are Looking For Dedicated Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Redefining Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following


Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills
Fluency in English and Spanish is required

Master’s or PhD degree program in Computer Research Science, Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field

Technologies

Programming Languages: Python

Title: Senior Data Scientist (GenAI & Customer Analytics)
Description:
Si para ti un modelo no termina cuando funciona en un notebook, sino cuando se convierte en una decisión, se activa en CRM, Media o Commerce y demuestra su impacto en negocio, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM buscamos a una persona que nos ayude a construir nuestra capacidad de Analytics, AI y Decisioning. Tu rol no será solo modelar: diseñarás modelos de Customer Intelligence y Growth y soluciones de GenAI y agentes, trabajarás con el cliente desde el discovery hasta la definición de acciones, y convertirás lo aprendido en activos reutilizables del Studio.

Lo que harás (de verdad):

Customer Intelligence y Growth


Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de segmentación, churn, propensity, LTV, forecasting, recomendación y optimización.


GenAI y Agentes


Construir soluciones de GenAI y agentes que automaticen análisis, generación de insights, recomendaciones y flujos de decisión.


Activación y Medición de Impacto


Conectar modelos y agentes con CRM, Loyalty, Media, Commerce y otros ecosistemas de activación, trabajando junto al equipo de Data Engineering.
Definir marcos de medición, experimentación e incrementalidad para cuantificar el impacto y optimizar decisiones.


Cliente, Activos y Preventa


Participar con el cliente desde el discovery hasta la presentación de resultados y la definición de acciones.
Crear activos propios de WAM, como modelos reutilizables, agentes, aceleradores, demos y metodologías.
Apoyar el offering y la preventa aterrizando casos de uso, solución técnica, esfuerzo y viabilidad.


Crecemos contigo, cuidamos de ti:


Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.
Modelo híbrido: Nos vemos 2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.
Banda salarial: Entre 50K-60K € brutos anuales.
Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.
Plan de Igualdad: Impulsamos la participación equitativa, el respeto y oportunidades justas para todas las personas.
Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.
Desarrollo profesional: Plan de desarrollo adaptado a tu perfil e inquietudes.
Jornada intensiva: Viernes hasta las 15:00h. Además este año en verano (22/06 al 11/09) y Navidad (desde el 21/12 al 8/01) trabajamos de 8 a 15.


Imprescindible (si no encaja con tu perfil, no es tu rol):


Experiencia: 5+ años en Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning o AI aplicada a negocio.
Python y SQL: Nivel avanzado, con capacidad hands-on para trabajar de forma autónoma con datos y modelos.
Modelado: Experiencia real desarrollando modelos predictivos y/o de optimización sobre problemas de negocio.
GenAI y agentes: Experiencia práctica con LLMs y GenAI. Necesitamos que hayas construido soluciones con RAG, agentes, tool calling, APIs o frameworks de orquestación.
Visión end-to-end: Capacidad para llevar un caso de uso desde el dato y el modelo hasta la decisión, la activación y la medición de impacto.
Datos de negocio: Experiencia con datos de cliente, marketing, comercial o digital, y comprensión de sus principales casos de uso.
Cloud e industrialización: Experiencia en al menos un entorno cloud (GCP, Azure o AWS) y conocimiento de prácticas de industrialización, Git y APIs.
Interlocución con cliente: Capacidad para explicar decisiones técnicas en términos de impacto de negocio.


Suma puntos si tienes:


Customer Intelligence y medición: Experiencia en CRM/Loyalty, MMM/MROI, causalidad, experimentación y optimización.
Ecosistema y operación: Experiencia con Salesforce / Data Cloud, MLOps/LLMOps o evaluación de agentes.

Title: Data Scientist, Parameta Solutions (Madrid)
Description:
Role Overview

We are on a mission to harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to shape the next generation of financial intelligence solutions. As we continue to expand our Data Science capability, we are seeking a talented and innovative Data Scientist to develop cutting-edge analytical and Generative AI solutions that drive commercial value across our business.




Based in Madrid and working within Parameta Solutions, you will play a key role in designing, developing and deploying scalable data products that transform complex financial data into actionable insights. Working closely with Data Engineering, Product, Commercial and Technology teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, cloud technologies and Generative AI capabilities to support the evolution of our data-driven product suite.




This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly growing function at the forefront of financial data innovation, helping to shape the future of analytics, intelligence and AI-powered solutions across the organisation.




Role Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain robust Python-based applications for financial data analysis, transformation, enrichment and automation.
Build scalable data science solutions that extract actionable insights from large and complex financial datasets.
Develop interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks and visualisation tools to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Enhance, support and continuously improve existing data applications, data quality frameworks and analytical platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers and commercial stakeholders to ensure the scalability, reliability and usability of data products and models.
Apply software engineering best practices, including modular development, code reviews, automated testing, version control and CI/CD methodologies.
Design, develop and maintain Generative AI solutions that enhance internal processes, analytical capabilities and customer-facing products.
Leverage AWS cloud technologies and services to build scalable AI and machine learning applications, making full use of innovative capabilities available through our strategic AWS partnership.
Evaluate emerging AI, machine learning and data science technologies, identifying opportunities to improve products, processes and client outcomes.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Parameta Solutions' data science and AI capabilities, helping establish best practices and technical standards across the team.




Experience / Competences

Essential

Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications within a data science, machine learning or quantitative analytics environment.
Demonstrated software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented programming, modular design patterns and version control.
Experience building and deploying analytical, machine learning or AI-driven solutions in a commercial environment.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying and manipulating large-scale datasets.
Experience working with modern data and engineering platforms such as Snowflake, Airflow, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience developing or integrating Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM) or machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated understanding of cloud-based architectures and services, particularly within AWS environments.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.




Desired

Industry experience in a computational or quantitative data science role.
Experience developing customer-facing analytics, recommendation engines or AI-powered products.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and model deployment, monitoring and governance frameworks.
Experience working within agile product and engineering environments.
Passion for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.




Job Band & Level

Professional / 5




#PARAMETA




About TP ICAP Group

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure. Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions. Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions. The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform. Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.




About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.




Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.




Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Únete a CGI!

Fundada en 1976, CGI se encuentra entre las mayores empresas de servicios de consultoría TI y de negocio del mundo. Nos basamos en conocimientos y resultados para ayudar a acelerar la transformación digital de nuestros clientes. A través de 21 sectores en 400 ubicaciones en todo el mundo, nuestros 94.000 profesionales proporcionan servicios de consultoría TI y de negocio integrales, escalables y sostenibles que entregamos localmente.3 years of experience in a similar environment.

Buscamos un/a Data Scientist para incorporarse a un proyecto relevante dentro del sector asegurador, participando en iniciativas de Machine Learning, Inteligencia Artificial y Analítica Avanzada con impacto directo en negocio.




Responsabilidades

Trabajar con diferentes áreas para entender problemas de negocio y traducirlos en casos de uso de Data Science.
Explorar, preparar y analizar datos para identificar patrones y oportunidades.
Diseñar, desarrollar y validar modelos estadísticos y de Machine Learning.
Realizar feature engineering y evaluar diferentes aproximaciones de modelización.
Interpretar los resultados y traducirlos en conclusiones comprensibles y accionables para negocio.
Colaborar con otros perfiles de Data, Engineering y Tecnología para llevar los modelos hacia entornos productivos.
Participar en la evolución y monitorización de modelos una vez desplegados.
Trabajar dentro de un entorno tecnológico moderno de datos y analítica avanzada.




Requisitos

Sobre todo, una persona con una buena base de Data Science y estadística, curiosidad por entender el negocio y ganas de construir soluciones que lleguen a utilizarse en el mundo real.

Nos gustaría que aportaras:

Experiencia profesional desarrollando proyectos de Data Science / Machine Learning.
Buenos conocimientos de estadística y modelización.
Experiencia con técnicas de Machine Learning supervisadas y/o no supervisadas.
Buen nivel de Python y SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con datos desde su exploración y preparación hasta la evaluación de modelos.
Capacidad para entender problemas de negocio y comunicar los resultados de manera clara.
Interés por participar en todo el ciclo de vida de una solución de Data Science y no únicamente en su fase experimental.

Nos ayudará especialmente si además tienes...

Experiencia en sector Seguros o en otros sectores intensivos en datos como banca, fintech, telco, utilities o similares.
Experiencia con Databricks, PySpark o Apache Spark.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Conocimientos de cloud y MLOps.
Experiencia con modelos ya desplegados en producción y su monitorización.
Conocimiento de problemáticas como fraude, pricing/riesgo, propensión, churn, segmentación, forecasting, recomendación o customer analytics.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

Fundada en 1976, CGI se encuentra entre las mayores empresas de servicios de consultoría TI y de negocio del mundo. Nos basamos en conocimientos y resultados para ayudar a acelerar la transformación digital de nuestros clientes. A través de 21 sectores en 400 ubicaciones en todo el mundo, nuestros 94.000 profesionales proporcionan servicios de consultoría TI y de negocio integrales, escalables y sostenibles que entregamos localmente.3 years of experience in a similar environment.

Buscamos un/a Data Scientist para incorporarse a un proyecto relevante dentro del sector asegurador, participando en iniciativas de Machine Learning, Inteligencia Artificial y Analítica Avanzada con impacto directo en negocio.


Responsabilidades

  • Trabajar con diferentes áreas para entender problemas de negocio y traducirlos en casos de uso de Data Science.
  • Explorar, preparar y analizar datos para identificar patrones y oportunidades.
  • Diseñar, desarrollar y validar modelos estadísticos y de Machine Learning.
  • Realizar feature engineering y evaluar diferentes aproximaciones de modelización.
  • Interpretar los resultados y traducirlos en conclusiones comprensibles y accionables para negocio.
  • Colaborar con otros perfiles de Data, Engineering y Tecnología para llevar los modelos hacia entornos productivos.
  • Participar en la evolución y monitorización de modelos una vez desplegados.
  • Trabajar dentro de un entorno tecnológico moderno de datos y analítica avanzada.


Requisitos

Sobre todo, una persona con una buena base de Data Science y estadística, curiosidad por entender el negocio y ganas de construir soluciones que lleguen a utilizarse en el mundo real.

Nos gustaría que aportaras:

  • Experiencia profesional desarrollando proyectos de Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Buenos conocimientos de estadística y modelización.
  • Experiencia con técnicas de Machine Learning supervisadas y/o no supervisadas.
  • Buen nivel de Python y SQL.
  • Experiencia trabajando con datos desde su exploración y preparación hasta la evaluación de modelos.
  • Capacidad para entender problemas de negocio y comunicar los resultados de manera clara.
  • Interés por participar en todo el ciclo de vida de una solución de Data Science y no únicamente en su fase experimental.

Nos ayudará especialmente si además tienes...

  • Experiencia en sector Seguros o en otros sectores intensivos en datos como banca, fintech, telco, utilities o similares.
  • Experiencia con Databricks, PySpark o Apache Spark.
  • Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.
  • Conocimientos de cloud y MLOps.
  • Experiencia con modelos ya desplegados en producción y su monitorización.
  • Conocimiento de problemáticas como fraude, pricing/riesgo, propensión, churn, segmentación, forecasting, recomendación o customer analytics.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Biologics Discovery
Description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Science

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Madrid, Spain, Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

About The Opportunity

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Senior Data Scientist dedicated to our Biologics Discovery organization. This role sits within our Data Science team and partners closely with our In Silico Discovery (ISD) organization - the group that builds the molecular design and property-prediction models (for example, developability, affinity and binding, and other molecular-property and liability-risk models) that guide which biologic molecules to design, make, and advance. ISD owns core molecular model development; you will build the data-facing ML capabilities (featurization, model-ready datasets) that make ISD's models faster to build and better to trust.

This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-095854

Spain - Requisition Number: R-096793

Why this role matters: Biologics Discovery is generating rich, fast-growing data across assays, sequences, and modalities, and the opportunity now is to make that data fully model-ready and seamlessly available for ML. This role ensures biologics data is structured for training, and that applied ML on discovery data helps scientists prioritize molecules, flag risks, and generate hypotheses earlier - strengthening the interface to ISD's models rather than duplicating them.

Position Summary

You will design robust featurization approaches and curate standardized, traceable, model-ready datasets from biologics assay, biophysical, sequence, and construct data. You operate at the interface between our data-generating and data-infrastructure partners and In Silico Discovery (ISD), ensuring the datasets and features you create strengthen ISD's molecular property models. This is an opportunity to shape how AI learns from every biologics experiment.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Data Analysis & Enablement


Apply modern data science tools to explore, integrate, and characterize heterogeneous biologics discovery data (e.g., antibody/protein sequence, construct, assay, and biophysical data).
Work with discovery scientists to translate scientific questions and DMTL (design-make-test-learn) decision points into clear data and analytical requirements.
Identify data quality issues, biases, gaps, and risks such as leakage or distribution shift that could affect downstream modeling or scientific interpretation.
Support the effective use of data for molecule prioritization, risk identification, and hypothesis generation.


Featurization & Model-Ready Data


Develop featurization and model-ready datasets from biologics discovery data.
Work with data engineers to specify the features, labels, and levels of aggregation that models need, preserving raw representations where information matters.
Curate, document, and version datasets so modeling is reproducible and traceable.


Partnership, Rigor & Growth


Collaborate with ISD to hand off standardized, traceable training datasets and align on where Data Science enables versus where ISD owns modeling.
Partner with Discovery scientists to frame ML problems around real decision points in the design-make-test-learn (DMTL) cycle.
Work closely with ontology and MLOps colleagues so datasets carry consistent semantics and models move reliably from development into use.
Champion reproducibility, documentation, and responsible AI.


Why This Role Is Unique

This is an opportunity to apply ML where it truly moves the needle in biologics discovery - grounded in real assay and sequence data, tightly partnered with world-class molecular modeling, and with real room to grow your scope, technical leadership, and impact as you build a track record of delivery.

Qualifications

Required


Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, or a related field.
At least 2 years of applied ML experience, including model development, evaluation, and dataset curation on complex scientific or biomedical data.
Strong proficiency with Python and the modern ML stack (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn) and SQL.
Experience turning complex, heterogeneous experimental data into robust features and training sets, with exposure to cloud training and data infrastructure.
Sound understanding of evaluation, validation, and the risks of leakage and distribution shift.
Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental scientists and modeling partners in a matrixed R&D environment.


Preferred


Experience with biologics, antibody/protein sequence models, or protein language models.
Experience with active learning, Bayesian optimization, or sequence-based generative models for molecular design.
Familiarity with biophysical/assay data and developability endpoints.
Experience with MLOps, experiment tracking, and model monitoring.
Familiarity with how ontologies or knowledge graphs support data reuse and AI-ready datasets.


This position will be based at one of our office locations in either Spring House, PA (strongly preferred), Titusville, NJ, or Raritan, NJ, USA; or Madrid, Spain. (No remote option.)

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.

Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $109,000 to $174,800. The Company maintains highly competitive, performance-based compensation programs. Under current guidelines, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. The annual performance bonus is a cash bonus intended to provide an incentive to achieve annual targeted results by rewarding for individual and the corporation’s performance over a calendar/performance year. Bonuses are awarded at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, business accident insurance, and group legal insurance.

Employees may be eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension) and savings plan (401(k)).

Employees Are Eligible For The Following Time Off Benefits

Vacation – up to 120 hours per calendar year

Sick time - up to 40 hours per calendar year

Holiday pay, including Floating Holidays – up to 13 days per calendar year of Work, Personal and Family Time - up to 40 hours per calendar year

Additional information can be found through the link below. https://www.careers.jnj.com/employee-benefits

The compensation and benefits information set forth in this posting applies to candidates hired in the United States. Candidates hired outside the United States will be eligible for compensation and benefits in accordance with their local market.
