Title: Data Scientist - AI & ML - Producto SaaS B2B
Description:
📍Ubicación: Barcelona ciudad – Sants-Les Corts

🕐Horario: Jornada completa partida con entrada y salida flexible y horario intensivo los viernes.

🏠Modelo híbrido: 3 días oficina/ 2 teletrabajo.

🚀 Incorporación: Inmediata




En Vincle buscamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para unirse a nuestro equipo de Desarrollo de Producto e impulsar nuevas capacidades de Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning y Analítica Predictiva.

Trabajarás en un entorno muy colaborativo junto a equipos de Producto, Arquitectura y Desarrollo, con un objetivo claro: convertir datos y oportunidades de negocio en funcionalidades inteligentes, escalables y con impacto real.

👉 Todo ello con impacto directo en nuestro producto SaaS B2B (CRM/SFA) y en clientes de sectores como Gran Consumo y Pharma.




🧩 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Transformar datos en capacidad real de producto: modelos predictivos, recomendaciones, optimización y nuevas funcionalidades basadas en IA.

Tu trabajo no se quedará en el análisis: llegará a producción y generará impacto real en negocio.




🚀 ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de Machine Learning y Analítica Predictiva.
Trabajar en casos de uso de predicción de ventas, forecasting, recomendación, optimización, detección de anomalías y segmentación.
Desarrollar motores de recomendación y mecanismos de scoring.
Investigar, evaluar y prototipar soluciones basadas en IA Generativa y LLMs.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo (Arquitectura, Tech Leads y Desarrollo) para integrar, desplegar, monitorizar y evolucionar los modelos en producción.
Participar en el desarrollo de asistentes inteligentes y capacidades conversacionales.
Trabajar con Prompts Engineering, arquitecturas RAG y enfoques híbridos que combinen IA generativa y modelos predictivos.
Traducir necesidades de negocio y producto en soluciones de IA técnicamente viables.
Medir, iterar y mejorar modelos para maximizar su impacto.




🔎 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

✅ Imprescindible

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Credit)
Description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role:

At Moniepoint, data is at the core of everything we do. We are a customer-centric company, and your work will enable our teams to make informed, data-driven decisions that directly impact the success of our business. We are seeking a data-driven, impact-oriented Senior Data Scientist to power Moniepoint’s consumer lending decisions at scale. You will build the models, experiments, and insights that shape how we acquire, underwrite, and retain millions of customers across Nigeria and Africa.

This role is pivotal in driving our pricing, credit limit modelling, and credit model deployment strategy in a growing business with unparalleled opportunities to give access to millions of customers. You’ll collaborate with our amazing Consumer Credit team and drive how we think about risk ranking, product offering, and data infrastructure to create the best personalised offers for our customers. You’ll be responsible for building our first suite of credit risk models and help drive a culture of how we should think about machine learning vs more traditional methods - bringing fresh thinking to inspire both the team and our customers.

Sitting at the intersection of data science, credit risk, and product, you’ll translate complex data into actionable decisions that drive growth with healthy portfolio performance.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You’ll Do


Develop and deploy credit scoring, affordability, and behavioural models to support underwriting, pricing, and collections
Design and run experiments to optimise approval rates, loss rates, and profitability
Partner with product squads to embed decision logic into real-time systems
Ensure data quality, compliance, and ethical use of models across all decisioning processes
Mentor product squads on best practices in experimentation and data-driven decision making
Provide models to optimise outcomes in collections, churn management and user retention


We would love to hear from you if…


You’re comfortable with Statistics - and have a Degree or qualifications in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or similar)
You have +5 years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within financial services
Working knowledge of credit risk, consumer lending, and regulatory considerations
Proficiency in SQL and at least one modelling/programming language (Python, R)
Experience with A/B testing, machine learning, collections modelling and churn management
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for business stakeholders
High ownership mindset and comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams


What we can offer you


Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, monthly bonuses, plus other benefits


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
A coding exercise on HackerRank - covering core data science theory (math, statistics, linear algebra) and Python fundamentals (data structures & algorithms).
A take-home assignment
A technical interview with a Lead in our Data Science Team to review your take-home assignment in depth
A behavioural and technical interview with the hiring manager


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Smadex is a leading advertising technology company founded in Barcelona in 2011 and sold to American-based and stock-listed Entravision in 2018 (NYSE::EVC). We are a fully transparent platform built with top technology, countless programmatic management features and powerful machine learning algorithms to help advertisers grow their business at scale. We are currently considered one of the top mobile ad-tech companies in the world.




As a Senior Data Scientist, you won’t just analyze data, you will actively shape the future of our mobile advertising platform. You will sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and business, transforming raw behavioral data from millions of global users into scalable strategies. We are looking for a high-caliber professional who thrives in ambiguity, sets high analytical standards, and translates complex insights into product decisions.




This is a full-time position based in Barcelona.




Product & ML Strategy Influence

Own the analytical loop that influences our Product and Machine Learning strategies. Use data to identify untapped opportunities and define what we build next.
Design, execute, and evaluate sophisticated experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, multivariate testing) to measure the impact of new product features and ML algorithms.
Establish and govern key performance frameworks to align cross-functional teams on what success looks like.




Scalable Analytics & Frameworks

Build reproducible data models, frameworks, and processes that allow the company to scale decision-making without reinventing the wheel.
Design high-impact data visualization assets that democratize data access and enable self-service insights for both technical and commercial stakeholders.




Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as the strategic data partner for engineering, product, and business teams, translating deep technical findings into actionable, high-level business recommendations.
Raise the bar for analytical rigor across the organization, mentoring junior team members and establishing best practices.




Skills & Requirements

Experience: 5+ years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or Product Analyst, preferably in high-growth tech environments or mobile ecosystems.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Economics).
Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience working with massive, complex datasets and modern cloud data warehouses
Statistical Rigor: Solid understanding of statistical concepts, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and regression methodologies.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to present complex technical conclusions to C-level executives and non-technical stakeholders with clarity and impact.
Ownership & Autonomy: Proven track record of owning projects from ambiguity to measurable business outcome. You are comfortable building the playbook, not just following it.




Preferred Qualifications (A Plus)

Strong background in the ad-tech industry, mobile programmatic advertising (DSP/SSP), or user acquisition (UA) dynamics.
Familiarity with mobile app measurement frameworks (MMPs) and concepts like LTV optimization or incrementality.
Experience working with global, distributed cross-functional teams.




Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered.




What is in it for you:

Integrate a highly motivated, young and dynamic team
Great compensation package
Top location at the heart of Barcelona with a rooftop terrace, Barbecue, and a fully stocked fridge
Great work-life balance: work from home (2 days per week), flexible hours
Meal vouchers - Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance
Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR and Wellhub
LinkedIn Learning and training opportunities
Monthly TGIF events
Regular team-building events
Fun and friendly work environment with talented marketers and engineers from over 40 countries
And more!

Title: Senior Data Scientist-Squad Personalización
Description:
En Mango vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

NUESTRO EUQIPO DE TECNOLOGÍA

Somos un equipo dinámico, motivado por las nuevas tecnologías, con pasión por lo que hacemos y ganas de asumir grandes retos que nos permitan seguir creciendo. Trabajamos con datos e inteligencia artificial para transformar Mango, apostando por la innovación y las soluciones agentic AI, siempre con la tecnología al servicio de las personas.

Estamos buscando un/a Senior Data Scientist para unirse a nuestro equipo de Data & Advanced Analytics, squad de Personalización.

El equipo de Advanced Analytics desarrolla algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial dirigidos a optimizar los procesos y decisiones más desafiantes dentro de la industria del retail. Está formado por Data Scientists, Big Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Deep Learning Researchers y Software Engineers que trabajan juntos en squads multidisciplinares para desarrollar algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial aprovechando la última tecnología en plataformas de Big Data y computación distribuida.

Cada uno de los squads de Advanced Analytics tiene como objetivo desarrollar y evolucionar algoritmos para hacer frente a algunos de los principales retos técnicos y empresariales de Mango.

El squad de Personalización, al que se incorporará la persona seleccionada, es responsable de desarrollar algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial para proporcionar una experiencia personalizada a los clientes de Mango, tanto en el sitio web y la app como en las comunicaciones por email o push. Aprovechando el gran volumen de datos de compras y de navegación de los clientes, los algoritmos desarrollados incluyen recomendaciones de productos, segmentaciones de clientes, el buscador de mango.com, un asistente conversacional de IA que actúa como asesor de moda para nuestros clientes o la generación de contenido personalizado mediante IA generativa, asegurando su despliegue en tiempo real.

Todos los proyectos se desarrollan en la nube de AWS utilizando una variedad de herramientas y servicios avanzados. Entre ellos se incluyen Amazon S3 para almacenamiento, AWS Lambda para computación sin servidor, y diversas APIs para la integración de servicios. Además, empleamos Apache Airflow para la orquestación y programación de flujos de trabajo, y Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) para la gestión de contenedores y Jenkins para su despliegue. Utilizamos Databricks para nuestro Datalake.

TU NUEVO PUESTO

Title: Principal Data Scientist, Generative Recommendations & Agentic Orchestration- Spain Remote
Description:
Who We Are

At Vista, we are building an industry-leading Customer Relevance Platform to scale personalization across products, design templates, and marketing messages. We are moving away from 'model sprawl' toward a unified architecture centered on fmX, a foundation model that learns shared embeddings for all relevant entities for Vista (users, products, marketing messages, templates, etc.).

Our strategic vision focuses on delivering a "Context-aware Customer Experience." To achieve this, we are prioritizing the evolution toward Intent-Based Personalization, capturing real-time journey signals, and infusing our recommendations into Agentic Experiences. This means equipping AI assistants with an Agentic Reasoning Layer that sits on top of our fmX rankers, enabling personalized recommendations to fit seamlessly into agentic workflows and user experiences.

What You Will Do

As the Principal Data Scientist, you will drive the generative, intent-based, and agentic evolution of our platform. A critical part of your role will be to act as the primary bridge between traditional data science practices (ranking, embeddings, deep learning) and advanced LLM / Agentic reasoning layers. You will partner directly with another Principal Data Scientist to co-lead our research agenda, accelerating our strategic progress and elevating the capabilities of the wider Data Science team.


Bridging Data Science & Agentic Experiences (Key Responsibility): Act as the primary technical bridge between core ML/DS modeling and modern LLM application layers. Translate classical recommendations, graph embeddings, and fmX outputs into robust reasoning abstractions for use in agentic workflows.
Agentic Reasoning & Recommendations: Lead the evolution of recommendations into the Generative AI era. Design and build the agentic reasoning layer that wraps around our fmX models and rankers. Implement patterns that allow models to self-correct, reason, and contextually explain recommendations to customers.
Tool-Use & MCP Architecture: Architect and build the ML pathways and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose core recommendation models and data as modular tools for AI agents. This allows conversational shopping experiences to dynamically query, rank, and synthesize candidates in real time.
Intent-Based Personalization: Develop an algorithmic intent layer that translates real-time browsing and session signals into structured, context-aware customer intents to feed directly into the fmX-based recommendation pipeline.
Broad Personalization & Segmentation: Build advanced propensity models and leverage behavioral traits to drive actionable, business-aligned customer segmentations and dynamic personas.
AI Leadership & Strategy: Act as Vista's AI ambassador, influencing product, engineering, and business leadership to adopt a model-driven, agent-first approach. Ensure models integrate cleanly with delivery systems without hurting Core Web Vitals or caching efficiency.


Your Qualifications


Advanced degree (Ph.D. or Master's) in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field.
8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning models and deep learning systems into high-scale customer experiences.
Hands-on experience and proactive experimentation with Agentic AI, AI Agent Orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Strands, etc.), and building reasoning layers (such as advanced chain-of-thought, self-correction, or validation loops).
Demonstrated experience or active thinking/experimentation in building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to bridge data/ML systems with LLM orchestrators in a production context.
Deep expertise in Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Reinforcement Learning (especially applied to real-time feedback loops or personalized ranking).
Proven track record of building propensity models and customer segmentation models on large-scale behavioral data.
Expert-level proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and SQL.
Strong architectural understanding of how ML models interact with both backend pipelines (Databricks, Snowflake, streaming features) and frontend delivery systems (UI rendering, caching strategies, latency management).
Very strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to translate complex statistical and algorithmic concepts into clear business value to influence non-technical leaders and align cross-functional engineering teams.


Why You'll Love Working Here

There is a lot to love about working at VistaPrint. We are an award winning Remote-First company. We’re an inclusive community. We’re growing (which means you can too). And to help orient us all in the same direction, we have our Vista Behaviors which exemplify the behavioral attributes that make us a culturally strong and high-performing team.

About Us

VistaPrint is the design and marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For over 20 years we’ve been inspired by small businesses, and we work incessantly to deliver solutions to their evolving needs. Together, VistaCreate, 99designs by Vista and VistaPrint represent a full-service design, digital and print solution, elevating small businesses’ presence in physical and digital spaces and powering them to achieve success. VistaPrint is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in-store, online and on-the-go.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion

VistaPrint exists to help our customers live their dreams. Each dream is unique – and the VistaPrint team needs to be as well. We believe in the unique contributions of everyone within a diverse global organization. We are collaborative, inclusive, and innovative. We strive to role model and live an inclusive culture of fairness, respect and belonging for all. And we work together to empower each other, creating a space in which each of us can spark our next great idea.

Title: Staff Data Scientist - Paid Marketing Optimization
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

At Preply, we're growing a talented Data Team to empower top-notch decision-making across our organization. Our team collaborates closely with various other chapters - including product, business, and platform - leveraging analysis, experimentation, causal inference, and machine learning.

You’ll be embedded in cross-functional teams, partnering with our MarTech Product Manager, Marketeers, Tech Leads, and the Data Strategy team. Check out our Tech Radar to see the tools and technologies we love using at Preply!

About this role:

This role requires a real interest in the marketing bidding universe and the ability to work with a lot of ambiguity. You will go deep into each channel, understand its bidding and optimization behavior, and derive data driven solutions to increase each channel's ROI through bidding, audience and creative optimization. Marketing brings the business questions, you define the success metrics and the modeling approach to answer them. A lot of this is untapped territory and there is nothing off the shelf to buy, so inventing the approach and convincing your stakeholders of it is a big part of the job.

What you’ll be doing:


Design our Creative Analytics framework (creative performance modeling) - Own, design and develop our Creative Analytics Framework. Drive its findings into decisions with the creative and media-buying teams, and automate detection, reporting and action with MarTech. Longer term, build models that separate what a creative actually causes from what the algorithm’s delivery decides for it, so we can predict the incremental drivers of creative efficiency.
Cohort maturity prediction (conversion-lag prediction) - Minimize steering delay: predict how many of today’s clicks will convert, and connect today’s spend to conversions that haven’t happened yet.
Bidding signal optimization (value-based bidding) - Work with our channel managers and Applied AI team to improve the predicted conversion value we send to Google and Meta, iterating through which funnel events we optimise on and what predictions we attach to them. Predict too early and the signal is noisy, too late and the algorithm doesn’t get enough data to learn from.
Audience optimization (uplift modeling) - Create customer uplift models to identify incremental value and build audiences that improve marketing efficiency. Tell the networks who to look for and who to skip, and feed that back as prospecting seeds, remarketing audiences and exclusion lists.
Work closely with the Data Engineering and Applied AI team on scalable data pipelines, the evolution of our ETL processes, and the adoption of new tools and frameworks.


What you need to succeed:


Python, SQL and a distributed framework like Spark; we use Databricks.
Experience with marketing or attribution data, and a working understanding of how bidding platforms consume the signal you send them. You don't need to have run campaigns, but you should find how they behave genuinely interesting.
Advanced modelling. Propensity models to value earlier funnel events and refine targeting, and uplift models to identify incremental value.
Causal inference and experiment design. Separating what a channel drives from what it takes credit for, and designing the test that settles it when the platform controls delivery.
The instinct to turn a business hypothesis into something testable, and the honesty to say when the data can't answer it.
Comfort working across teams you don't control. This role runs on close collaboration with Applied AI, marketing measurement, MarTech and tracking, and CRM.


You might come from marketing DS, ads ML, recommender systems or any applied ML role where your model’s output fed another algorithm.

Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

You’ll be embedded in cross-functional teams, partnering with our MarTech Product Manager, Marketeers, Tech Leads, and the Data Strategy team. Check out our Tech Radar to see the tools and technologies we love using at Preply!

About this role:

This role requires a real interest in the marketing bidding universe and the ability to work with a lot of ambiguity. You will go deep into each channel, understand its bidding and optimization behavior, and derive data driven solutions to increase each channel's ROI through bidding, audience and creative optimization. Marketing brings the business questions, you define the success metrics and the modeling approach to answer them. A lot of this is untapped territory and there is nothing off the shelf to buy, so inventing the approach and convincing your stakeholders of it is a big part of the job.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design our Creative Analytics framework (creative performance modeling) - Own, design and develop our Creative Analytics Framework. Drive its findings into decisions with the creative and media-buying teams, and automate detection, reporting and action with MarTech. Longer term, build models that separate what a creative actually causes from what the algorithm’s delivery decides for it, so we can predict the incremental drivers of creative efficiency.
  • Cohort maturity prediction (conversion-lag prediction) - Minimize steering delay: predict how many of today’s clicks will convert, and connect today’s spend to conversions that haven’t happened yet.
  • Bidding signal optimization (value-based bidding) - Work with our channel managers and Applied AI team to improve the predicted conversion value we send to Google and Meta, iterating through which funnel events we optimise on and what predictions we attach to them. Predict too early and the signal is noisy, too late and the algorithm doesn’t get enough data to learn from.
  • Audience optimization (uplift modeling) - Create customer uplift models to identify incremental value and build audiences that improve marketing efficiency. Tell the networks who to look for and who to skip, and feed that back as prospecting seeds, remarketing audiences and exclusion lists.
  • Work closely with the Data Engineering and Applied AI team on scalable data pipelines, the evolution of our ETL processes, and the adoption of new tools and frameworks.

What you need to succeed:

  • Python, SQL and a distributed framework like Spark; we use Databricks.
  • Experience with marketing or attribution data, and a working understanding of how bidding platforms consume the signal you send them. You don't need to have run campaigns, but you should find how they behave genuinely interesting.
  • Advanced modelling. Propensity models to value earlier funnel events and refine targeting, and uplift models to identify incremental value.
  • Causal inference and experiment design. Separating what a channel drives from what it takes credit for, and designing the test that settles it when the platform controls delivery.
  • The instinct to turn a business hypothesis into something testable, and the honesty to say when the data can't answer it.
  • Comfort working across teams you don't control. This role runs on close collaboration with Applied AI, marketing measurement, MarTech and tracking, and CRM.

You might come from marketing DS, ads ML, recommender systems or any applied ML role where your model’s output fed another algorithm.

Why you’ll love it at Preply:

  • An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
  • A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
  • A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
  • Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
  • Access to free mental health support platforms;
  • Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
  • The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

  • Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Data Scientist

Title: Data Scientist | €48K - €54K
Description:
Una de las empresas con las que colaboramos en Joppy busca un/a Data Scientist para unirse al equipo.




Modalidad de trabajo: HÍBRIDA en Barcelona (1 dia/semana en oficina).




¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como Data Scientist en un entorno tecnológico de alto rendimiento, participando en proyectos complejos e innovadores en el sector transporte?




Buscamos un/a INGENIERO/A de CIENCIA DEL DATO para incorporarse a nuestra área de Data. Formarás parte de un equipo ubicado en Barcelona. Trabajarás en la creación de soluciones avanzadas basadas en analítica, modelos estadísticos y aprendizaje automático para diferentes unidades de negocio.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?




• Recolectar grandes volúmenes de datos no estructurados y estructurados desde archivos, bases de datos, APIs, etc., y transformarlos en un formato más comprensible.




• Realizar análisis exploratorios para entender la naturaleza y distribución de los datos, identificar patrones, correlaciones y visualizarlos de manera efectiva.




• Desarrollar y aplicar modelos predictivos, de optimización y estadísticos para resolver problemas de negocio específicos, como regresión, clasificación, clustering, series temporales, etc.




• Aplicar técnicas de estadística y Machine Learning para desarrollar modelos predictivos y generar insights accionables para las diferentes áreas de negocio.




• Evaluar y validar la precisión y el rendimiento de dichos modelos utilizando técnicas como la validación cruzada, conjuntos de prueba y métricas de desempeño adecuadas.




• Colaborar con el equipo de MLOps para integrar los modelos desarrollados en un entorno de producción.




• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con equipos interdisciplinarios como ingenieros de datos, analistas, expertos en el dominio y equipos de negocio para comprender los requisitos y objetivos del proyecto.




• Participar en la toma y definición de requisitos, identificando las necesidades de negocio y traduciendo problemas de negocio en casos de uso y soluciones analíticas.




• Comunicar de manera efectiva los análisis, resultados de los modelos e implicaciones a diferentes audiencias, incluyendo stakeholders no técnicos, a través de informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones comprensibles. El objetivo será facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos.




• Monitorizar el rendimiento de los modelos en producción, realizar mantenimientos periódicos y actualizarlos cuando sea necesario para garantizar su vigencia y precisión.




• Mantenerse actualizado en técnicas analíticas como machine learning, optimización, deep learning y análisis de texto.




Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?




• Education: Grado, Máster o Doctorado en Informática, Economía, ADE, Ciencia de Datos o un campo relacionado.




• Más de 3 años de experiencia en Data Science, con experiencia en almacenamiento de datos, procesos ETL e integración de datos. Se valorará especialmente experiencia trabajando de forma autónoma en proyectos de estadística y Machine Learning.




• Conocimiento avanzado de SQL: dominio en la escritura y optimización de consultas.




• Experiencia en desarrollo en entornos AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.




• Conocimiento profundo del modelado de datos, gobernanza y mejores prácticas de calidad.




• Capacidad para manipular y preprocesar grandes volúmenes de datos utilizando herramientas como SQL, Pandas o Polars.




• Experiencia en scripts de Python y familiaridad con bibliotecas y herramientas de Python.




• Experiencia práctica en técnicas de Machine Learning y estadística aplicada, incluyendo modelos predictivos, regresión, clasificación, clustering y/o series temporales.




• Se valorará tener conocimientos estadísticos: pruebas de hipótesis, análisis de regresión, distribuciones de probabilidad, etc.




• Se valorará dominio de librerías de visualización como Matplotlib, Seaborn, ggplot2, etc., para crear visualizaciones claras e informativas (Tableau es un plus).




• Experiencia en toma de requisitos, interlocución con stakeholders y comunicación de resultados analíticos a perfiles de negocio.




• Se valorará positivamente experiencia en áreas de negocio como Comercial, Ventas, Controlling u otras funciones donde el análisis de datos tenga impacto directo en la toma de decisiones.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




• Estabilidad desde el primer día, con contratación indefinida.




• Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (entre 48.000 - 54.000 euros brutos anuales).




• Horario flexible y un día de presencialidad por semana.




• Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.




• Seguro médico privado.




• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.




• Plan de pensiones con aportación empresarial complementaria.




• App de bienestar con acceso a gimnasios, actividades deportivas y profesionales especializados a precios reducidos.




• Eventos, afterworks y actividades solidarias para desconectar, compartir y conocer al equipo.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
HIPRA es una empresa farmacéutica y biotecnológica enfocada en la prevención y diagnóstico para salud animal y humana, con una amplia gama de vacunas altamente innovadoras y un avanzado servicio de diagnóstico.

Tiene una sólida presencia internacional en más de 40 países con filiales propias, 11 centros de diagnóstico y 6 plantas de producción ubicadas estratégicamente en Europa (España) y América (Brasil).

La investigación y el desarrollo constituyen el núcleo de su conocimiento. HIPRA dedica el 15% de su facturación anual a actividades de I+D que se concentran en la creación y aplicación de los últimos avances científicos para el desarrollo de vacunas innovadoras de la más alta calidad. Para darle un valor añadido a su experiencia en vacunación, la empresa también desarrolla dispositivos médicos y servicios de trazabilidad.







Actualmente, necesitamos incorporar un(a) nuevo(a) senior Data Scientist, dentro de la unidad de I+D Animal Health, situada en Aiguaviva (Girona).







Buscamos personas que:




Dispongan de una experiencia consolidada en bioestadística aplicada a R&D biomédica, farmacéutica o veterinaria con mínimo 5 años de experiencia.

Hayan finalizado un grado en bioestadística, estadística, data science, matemáticas o un grado en ciencias de la salud completado por un máster en bioestadística.

Que tengan experiencia consolidada en análisis de datos biomédicos, ensayos clínicos y manejo de grandes bases de datos.

Que tengan conocimientos o experiencia en estadística aplicada al desarrollo CMC, desarrollo de procesos, fabricación y control de calidad de productos biológicos.

Que sean usuarios/as habituales de paquetes estadísticos de análisis de datos (R, SAS, SPSS o STATA).

Que tengan conocimiento de Design of Experiments (DoE) y de metodologías estadísticas aplicadas al desarrollo y control de procesos.

Que tengan conocimientos de otros lenguajes de programación (Phython o similar)

Cuyos niveles de inglés sean altos a nivel escrito/oral y cuyos niveles de ofimática sean avanzados (Excel y base de datos).




Esperamos que el/la Senior Data Scientist tenga capacidad para trabajar con personal investigador y equipos multidisciplinares, aportar criterio estadístico en el diseño e interpretación de estudios y actuar con un elevado nivel de autonomía.







En Hipra podrás encontrar:




Aprendizaje continuo.

Una empresa en plena expansión, multinacional.

Ambiente multicultural, abierto a nuevas ideas.







Tareas principales del puesto:




- Gestionar proyectos de ciencia de datos, bioestadísticos o bioinformáticos.

- Interpretación y análisis de datos, desarrollo de modelos estadísticos y algoritmos para generar conocimiento para los proyectos y dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.

- Proporcionar apoyo estadístico de alta calidad a estudios, proyectos, ensayos clínicos, registros y la difusión pública de resultados con habilidades estadísticas avanzadas y conocimiento de la investigación en biomedicina.

- Colaborar con los investigadores para definir el diseño de los estudios, contribuir al redactado de los protocolos mediante el cálculo del tamaño de la muestra y las secciones estadísticas. Revisar y visar aproximación estadística de protocolos.

- Elaborar protocolos, informes estadísticos o bioinformáticos.




- Proporcionar apoyo en consulta/análisis de grandes bases de datos, tanto externas (especialmente de los campos de la bioinformática y la biomedicina) como internas (SAP, MES, etc.).




- Mantener y explorar nuevos conocimientos técnicos sobre la manipulación de datos, nuevas metodología estadística avanzada, bioinformática y nuevas herramientas de análisis de datos.




- Contribuir a la toma de decisiones estratégicas e innovar en la aplicación de la bioestadística, la bioinformática y/o la ciencia de datos. Aportar e implementar las ideas de mejora a aplicar utilizando los canales de comunicación adecuados.

- Velar por el cumplimiento de las normas, estándares de calidad (por ejemplo, BPL o GCP) y las buenas prácticas estadísticas aplicables a su área de trabajo.







HIPRA ofrece igualdad de oportunidades a todos sus trabajadores y trabajadoras.

Todos los/las solicitantes que reúnan los requisitos serán considerados para el puesto a cubrir, sin tener en cuenta el género, la raza, la nacionalidad, la condición de discapacidad o de edad.

Todas las decisiones de contratación se toman en base a los méritos, la competencia y las necesidades de la empresa.

La investigación y el desarrollo constituyen el núcleo de su conocimiento. HIPRA dedica el 15% de su facturación anual a actividades de I+D que se concentran en la creación y aplicación de los últimos avances científicos para el desarrollo de vacunas innovadoras de la más alta calidad. Para darle un valor añadido a su experiencia en vacunación, la empresa también desarrolla dispositivos médicos y servicios de trazabilidad.



Actualmente, necesitamos incorporar un(a) nuevo(a) senior Data Scientist, dentro de la unidad de I+D Animal Health, situada en Aiguaviva (Girona).



Buscamos personas que:


Dispongan de una experiencia consolidada en bioestadística aplicada a R&D biomédica, farmacéutica o veterinaria con mínimo 5 años de experiencia.

Hayan finalizado un grado en bioestadística, estadística, data science, matemáticas o un grado en ciencias de la salud completado por un máster en bioestadística.

Que tengan experiencia consolidada en análisis de datos biomédicos, ensayos clínicos y manejo de grandes bases de datos.

Que tengan conocimientos o experiencia en estadística aplicada al desarrollo CMC, desarrollo de procesos, fabricación y control de calidad de productos biológicos.

Que sean usuarios/as habituales de paquetes estadísticos de análisis de datos (R, SAS, SPSS o STATA).

Que tengan conocimiento de Design of Experiments (DoE) y de metodologías estadísticas aplicadas al desarrollo y control de procesos.

Que tengan conocimientos de otros lenguajes de programación (Phython o similar)

Cuyos niveles de inglés sean altos a nivel escrito/oral y cuyos niveles de ofimática sean avanzados (Excel y base de datos).


Esperamos que el/la Senior Data Scientist tenga capacidad para trabajar con personal investigador y equipos multidisciplinares, aportar criterio estadístico en el diseño e interpretación de estudios y actuar con un elevado nivel de autonomía.



En Hipra podrás encontrar:


Aprendizaje continuo.

Una empresa en plena expansión, multinacional.

Ambiente multicultural, abierto a nuevas ideas.



Tareas principales del puesto:


- Gestionar proyectos de ciencia de datos, bioestadísticos o bioinformáticos.

- Interpretación y análisis de datos, desarrollo de modelos estadísticos y algoritmos para generar conocimiento para los proyectos y dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.

- Proporcionar apoyo estadístico de alta calidad a estudios, proyectos, ensayos clínicos, registros y la difusión pública de resultados con habilidades estadísticas avanzadas y conocimiento de la investigación en biomedicina.

- Colaborar con los investigadores para definir el diseño de los estudios, contribuir al redactado de los protocolos mediante el cálculo del tamaño de la muestra y las secciones estadísticas. Revisar y visar aproximación estadística de protocolos.

- Elaborar protocolos, informes estadísticos o bioinformáticos.


- Proporcionar apoyo en consulta/análisis de grandes bases de datos, tanto externas (especialmente de los campos de la bioinformática y la biomedicina) como internas (SAP, MES, etc.).


- Mantener y explorar nuevos conocimientos técnicos sobre la manipulación de datos, nuevas metodología estadística avanzada, bioinformática y nuevas herramientas de análisis de datos.


- Contribuir a la toma de decisiones estratégicas e innovar en la aplicación de la bioestadística, la bioinformática y/o la ciencia de datos. Aportar e implementar las ideas de mejora a aplicar utilizando los canales de comunicación adecuados.

- Velar por el cumplimiento de las normas, estándares de calidad (por ejemplo, BPL o GCP) y las buenas prácticas estadísticas aplicables a su área de trabajo.



HIPRA ofrece igualdad de oportunidades a todos sus trabajadores y trabajadoras.

Todos los/las solicitantes que reúnan los requisitos serán considerados para el puesto a cubrir, sin tener en cuenta el género, la raza, la nacionalidad, la condición de discapacidad o de edad.

Todas las decisiones de contratación se toman en base a los méritos, la competencia y las necesidades de la empresa.

Title: Junior data scientist
Description:
Take your career to the next level with Amaris Consulting as a Junior Data Scientist. Be part of an international team, thrive in a global group with a €800M turnover and over 1,000 clients worldwide, and work in an agile environment. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in developing and deploying AI and Machine Learning solutions in production environments, transforming business challenges into data-driven opportunities. Spanish fluency is required as part of this role.




✍️ WHAT WOULD YOU NEED? ✍️

3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or similar role.
Strong proficiency with Python for Machine Learning and AI development.
Experience with Deep Learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch.
Solid knowledge of Machine Learning algorithms, neural networks, model evaluation techniques, and software development best practices, as well as version control tools such as Git.
Familiarity with AWS services (S3, Lambda), Databricks, MongoDB, Apache Airflow, Jenkins, and Big Data technologies.
Proven experience with end-to-end Machine Learning project development and deployment in production environments.
Advanced proficiency in Spanish (written and spoken).
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.




👉 WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

Develop, prototype, and deploy AI and Machine Learning solutions to address complex business challenges.
Create rapid Proofs of Concept using Python, Streamlit, and Machine Learning frameworks.
Design, optimize, and maintain data pipelines, models, and analytical solutions to ensure scalability and performance.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Product teams, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful data-driven solutions.
Participate in the development of forecasting models, optimization algorithms, recommendation systems, Computer Vision, NLP, and Generative AI initiatives.
Implement Machine Learning and Deep Learning models in production environments using cloud and Big Data technologies.
Stay current with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, and Generative AI.




🚀 WHY US? 🚀

Join our dynamic team of talented people and discover a world full of growth and opportunity. Here's what we offer:

Rapid growth through a personalised career path and salary assessment. 70% of our senior leaders started in entry-level positions.
Improve your skills through our Technology Academy catalogue, Udemy platform, language classes, webinars and workshops.
Take control of your training with a personal annual budget and company-paid certifications.
Enjoy flexible policies, remote work options and excellent social benefits such as transport and restaurant tickets, childcare support and private health insurance.
Benefit from our WeCare programme, which supports employees in critical situations.
Unlock your full potential, both professionally and personally.




Amaris Consulting prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive work environment. Title: Senior Data Scientist - Insights
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

At Preply, data is at the heart of every decision we make. We run hundreds of A/B tests to continually optimize our product, each with its own analytical and tracking challenges. The complexity of our subscription model, along with the unique dynamics of tutor-learner interactions, offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to make a real impact.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be a key player in shaping the future of our product and driving our strategy forward. Embedded within a cross-functional squad, you’ll collaborate closely with product managers, tech leads, designers, and other key stakeholders to deliver data-driven insights that shape business decisions.

Our Data Team is dedicated to empowering top-quality decision-making. Do you want to know how? Visit our Tech Radar to learn about the technologies we use at Preply!

What You’ll Be Doing


Develop a deep understanding of the dynamics of our product, including user behavior and the economics of Preply’s marketplace.
Focus on the continuous improvement of our platform by gathering and analyzing data to uncover valuable insights that will shape product evolution and strategy.
Analyze customer behavior and product usage, improve our understanding of what drives retention and effectively communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive informed decision-making.
Quantify and model the impact of new product features and initiatives, identifying growth opportunities and contributing to the prioritization of our product roadmap.
Help define key performance indicators, tracking events, and engagement metrics that align with business goals and product improvements.
Design, execute, and evaluate large-scale experiments to test new ideas and measure their effectiveness in driving business outcomes.
Build strong relationships with data and technical leaders to foster collaboration and drive cross-team initiatives.


What You Need To Succeed


Experience in data analytics working with product teams, experimenting and uncovering opportunities for product optimization.
Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests with a strong grasp of relevant statistical concepts.
Strong understanding of data analysis concepts such as conversion, LTV, cohort analysis, retention, etc.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python), with the ability to write efficient and scalable code.
Curiosity, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, as well as the ability to proactively identify and address challenges.
Ability to craft compelling stories with data and communicate complex insights in a clear and engaging way, driving change among diverse stakeholders.
Interest in the bigger picture, feeling excited to impact the product roadmap and strategy.


Nice to have


Background in 2-sided marketplaces or digital businesses (B2B, B2C, B2B2C).
Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap).
Familiarity with machine learning techniques and how they can be applied to enhance user behavior predictions or product recommendations.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field.
Previous experience in mentoring or coaching others.


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – AI & Supply Chain
Description:
About Accenture Data & AI For Supply Chain Team

We are a global Center of Excellence specializing in Data & AI for Supply Chain, with a rapidly growing team of 200+ professionals. Our mission is to turn data into a strategic advantage, driving operational excellence, agility, and smarter, faster decision-making across the end-to-end supply chain.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for passionate professionals to join our team and shape the future of intelligent supply chains.

Our Focus Areas



Supply Chain Planning – AI-driven demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and planning solutions to enhance agility and efficiency.

Fulfillment & Network Optimization – Advanced analytics to optimize logistics, warehouse management, distribution, network and last-mile delivery, improving speed, cost, and service levels.

Manufacturing – AI, machine learning, and IoT to drive predictive maintenance, production efficiency, and quality control in smart manufacturing.



Your role

As a Data Scientist in Accenture’s Data & AI for Supply Chain team, you will:



Apply AI, advanced analytics, and optimization techniques to solve complex supply chain challenges.

Engage directly with clients, translating business needs into AI-driven solutions and delivering measurable impact.

Drive business development, contributing to proposals, identifying new opportunities, and shaping innovative AI offerings.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including data scientists, engineers, and business consultants, to implement cutting-edge supply chain solutions



What Skills Are We Looking For?

Basic Qualifications

✔ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

✔ Proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus).

✔ 4+ years of experience in Data & AI or related fields (we are hiring at different experience levels).

Technical Skills

We seek professionals with strong expertise in AI, analytics, and optimization applied to supply chain challenges. While you don’t need to master all of them, experience in multiple areas will be highly valuable. Key skills include:



Programming: Python, R, SQL

Operation Reasearch & Simulation: LP, ILP, Heuristics/Meta-Heuristics, Discrete Events Simulation, digital twins.

Machine Learning & AI: Forecasting, predictive modeling, optimization algorithms.

Generative AI: LLMs, AI-driven scenario generation, synthetic data modeling, and workflow automation.

Cloud & Big Data: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI/ML services.

Supply Chain Solutions: Familiarity with o9, Blue Yonder (BY), SAP IBP, or similar tools.

Data Engineering & Visualization: Large-scale data processing, market solutions/platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, ..), and tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.



 

Soft & Strategic Skills

Beyond technical expertise, we look for professionals who can think strategically, collaborate effectively, and drive impact in complex environments. Key skills include:



Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze supply chain challenges and design AI-driven solutions.

Business Acumen: Understanding the impact of AI and analytics on supply chain efficiency, resilience, and cost reduction.

Communication & Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Agility & Innovation: Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation.



 

What’s in It for You?

Join Accenture’s Data & AI for Supply Chain team and unlock a challenging and rewarding career, where you will:



Work on high-impact AI & analytics projects with global clients.

Collaborate with a team of 200+ data scientists and engineers, including 20% PhDs in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or Statistics.

Drive cutting-edge AI innovation, including Generative AI applications in supply chain.

Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work model in a Great Place to Work® recognized company.



Additional Benefits:



Comprehensive insurance (medical, life, and accident).

Wellness programs and medical services.

Flexible compensation programs & stock purchase plans.

Sustainability initiatives & Accenture Foundation programs.

Diversity & inclusion networks in a globally recognized company.

Flexibility programs (customized schedules, extra vacation days, etc.).



If you are excited about leading AI-driven transformations in supply chain, we’d love to hear from you!

Description:

Desde Oxigent Technologies seleccionamos un/a INGENIERO/A DATA SCIENTIST para trabajar en la creación de soluciones avanzadas basadas en analítica, modelos estadísticos y aprendizaje automático para diferentes unidades de negocio.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?

• Recolectar grandes volúmenes de datos no estructurados y estructurados desde archivos, bases de datos, APIs, etc., y transformarlos en un formato más comprensible.

• Realizar análisis exploratorios para entender la naturaleza y distribución de los datos, identificar patrones, correlaciones y visualizarlos de manera efectiva.

• Desarrollar y aplicar modelos predictivos, de optimización y estadísticos para resolver problemas de negocio específicos, como regresión, clasificación, clustering, series temporales, etc.

• Aplicar técnicas de estadística y Machine Learning para desarrollar modelos predictivos y generar insights accionables para las diferentes áreas de negocio.

• Evaluar y validar la precisión y el rendimiento de dichos modelos utilizando técnicas como la validación cruzada, conjuntos de prueba y métricas de desempeño adecuadas.

• Colaborar con el equipo de MLOps para integrar los modelos desarrollados en un entorno de producción.

• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con equipos interdisciplinarios como ingenieros de datos, analistas, expertos en el dominio y equipos de negocio para comprender los requisitos y objetivos del proyecto.

• Participar en la toma y definición de requisitos, identificando las necesidades de negocio y traduciendo problemas de negocio en casos de uso y soluciones analíticas.

• Comunicar de manera efectiva los análisis, resultados de los modelos e implicaciones a diferentes audiencias, incluyendo stakeholders no técnicos, a través de informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones comprensibles. El objetivo será facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Monitorizar el rendimiento de los modelos en producción, realizar mantenimientos periódicos y actualizarlos cuando sea necesario para garantizar su vigencia y precisión.

• Mantenerse actualizado en técnicas analíticas como machine learning, optimización, deep learning y análisis de texto.




Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?

• Education: Grado, Máster o Doctorado en Informática, Economía, ADE, Ciencia de Datos o un campo relacionado.

• Más de 2 años de experiencia en Data Science, con experiencia en almacenamiento de datos, procesos ETL e integración de datos. Se valorará especialmente experiencia trabajando de forma autónoma en proyectos de estadística y Machine Learning.

• Conocimiento avanzado de SQL: dominio en la escritura y optimización de consultas.

• Experiencia en desarrollo en entornos AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.

• Conocimiento profundo del modelado de datos, gobernanza y mejores prácticas de calidad.

• Capacidad para manipular y preprocesar grandes volúmenes de datos utilizando herramientas como SQL, Pandas o Polars.

• Experiencia en scripts de Python y familiaridad con bibliotecas y herramientas de Python.

• Experiencia práctica en técnicas de Machine Learning y estadística aplicada, incluyendo modelos predictivos, regresión, clasificación, clustering y/o series temporales.

• Se valorará tener conocimientos estadísticos: pruebas de hipótesis, análisis de regresión, distribuciones de probabilidad, etc.

• Se valorará dominio de librerías de visualización como Matplotlib, Seaborn, ggplot2, etc., para crear visualizaciones claras e informativas (Tableau es un plus).

• Experiencia en toma de requisitos, interlocución con stakeholders y comunicación de resultados analíticos a perfiles de negocio.

• Se valorará positivamente experiencia en áreas de negocio como Comercial, Ventas, Controlling u otras funciones donde el análisis de datos tenga impacto directo en la toma de decisiones.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Contratación indefinida.

• Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (entre 48.000 - 54.000 euros brutos anuales).

• Horario flexible.

• Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.

• Seguro médico privado.

• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.

• Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios y actividades deportivas en toda España con descuentos.

• ¡Y muchos otros beneficios!




¡Únete al equipo de Oxigent! Empresa comprometida con la sostenibilidad y la igualdad de oportunidades, donde el talento y la tecnología no entienden de género.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:



Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.



Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS



Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.



Nice to Have:



Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.



Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)



Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training in English, Spanish, and French.
Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).



Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Datavant is looking for an enthusiastic and meticulous junior Data Scientist to join our growing team. In this role, you will work with large, complex healthcare datasets to play a critical role in mitigating the disclosure risk of these datasets. You will collaborate closely with teams across the company, translating privacy requirements into data queries.

As part of the team, you will develop your skills in querying and manipulating large-scale datasets, primarily using SQL and Python, while working cross-functionally with stakeholders across privacy data science, engineering, product, and business teams. You will be supported in growing your technical skill set as you take on increasing responsibility.

You Will


Query, manipulate, and modify large datasets using SQL and Python
Work extensively within Snowflake to build queries, transformations, and data pipelines
Ensure data accuracy and integrity through careful validation and quality checks


What You Will Bring To The Table


Proficiency in SQL for querying, joining, and manipulating large datasets
Experience with Python for data analysis and manipulation
Critical hands-on experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to a range of audiences
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and build relationships across teams
Strong time management skills and the ability to prioritise work to meet deadlines
Initiative and a desire to independently learn new tools, techniques, and concepts
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS
Bonus: Experience with version control (e.g., Git)


To ensure the safety of patients and staff, many of our clients require post-offer health screenings and proof and/or completion of various vaccinations such as the flu shot, Tdap, COVID-19, etc. Any requests to be exempted from these requirements will be reviewed by Datavant Human Resources and determined on a case-by-case basis. Depending on the state in which you will be working, exemptions may be available on the basis of disability, medical contraindications to the vaccine or any of its components, pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions, and/or religion.

This job is not eligible for employment sponsorship.

Datavant is committed to a work environment free from job discrimination. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. Know Your Rights, explore the resources available through the EEOC for more information regarding your legal rights and protections. In addition, Datavant does not and will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.

If you choose to respond, your answers will be anonymous and will help us identify areas for improvement in our recruitment process. (We can only see aggregate responses, not individual ones. Title: Data Scientist F/M
Description:
Sixense Satellite, a subsidiary of VINCI Construction, is a leading player in satellite-based ground monitoring. We develop advanced technologies combining remote sensing, InSAR, and data science to deliver high-impact decision-support solutions for infrastructure management, natural hazard monitoring, and land-use planning.

As part of the VINCI Construction group, we help our clients better understand and anticipate ground deformation phenomena through Earth observation data and cutting-edge technologies.

About the Role :

Sixense Satellite is looking for a Data Scientist to join our team and contribute to the development of our Atlas InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) processing chain. You'll work on both maintaining and extending core processing capabilities, and on building new features that push our satellite-based ground deformation monitoring products forward.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of remote sensing, geophysics, and applied machine learning.

What You'll Do :


Contribute to the design, development, and optimization of our InSAR tools and chain
Implement new functionalities and features to expand processing capabilities and product offerings
Design and deploy machine learning models, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for tasks such as phase unwrapping, atmospheric correction, anomaly/deformation detection, and signal classification
Work with large volumes of SAR and interferometric data, building robust and scalable pipelines
Collaborate closely with geophysicists, radar engineers, and software developers to translate research into production-ready tools
Validate model outputs against ground truth and domain expertise; iterate based on real-world performance
Contribute to technical documentation and internal knowledge sharing



What We're Looking For :


Degree (MSc/PhD) in Data Science, Computer Science, Geophysics, Remote Sensing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
Experience in machine learning, with hands-on expertise in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Strong Python programming skills; experience with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, xarray, etc.)
