This is a newly created role designed to address one of the most critical gaps identified in the category diagnostic: the absence of a structured pricing framework, a clear performance intelligence function, and a structured competitive monitoring capability. Today, pricing decisions lack governance, performance tracking is high-level, and competitive intelligence is fragmented. This role exists to fix that.


You will build the analytical backbone of Category Management — providing the data, frameworks, and strategic insight that make better portfolio decisions possible, and ensuring that pricing logic holds across markets, channels, and the full product lifecycle.



What you'll do:

1. Category Performance Intelligence



  • Design, build and own global category performance dashboards in partnership with BI and Data teams

  • Define the KPI framework for the category: which metrics matter, how they are measured, and at what frequency

  • Track and analyse product performance across all global markets:

    • Revenue, volume, and margin by SKU, channel, and market

    • Return rate and NPS correlation with product attributes and positioning

    • Portfolio mix evolution and contribution margin by tier

    • Channel performance across DTC, marketplace, and retail





  • Identify performance gaps, growth opportunities, and structural category issues — and translate them into clear recommendations

  • Produce monthly performance reviews and quarterly category performance deep-dives for senior stakeholders

  • Build the category portfolio assessment framework (combining CM, return rate, revenue, and mix) to steer investment and rationalisation decisions




2. Pricing Architecture & Value Capture



  • Design and maintain global price ladders, pricing tiers, and trade-up logic for each product category

  • Define pricing corridors by channel, market cluster, and product tier — ensuring coherence across the portfolio

  • Maintain & update a pricing elasticity model to inform strategic pricing decisions and promotional planning

  • Support pricing decisions for new product launches — working closely with Global Category Managers and Finance

  • Conduct regular price-value assessments: are products priced coherently relative to consumer-perceived value and competitive positioning?

  • Identify pricing risks (undercutting, margin compression, channel conflict) and propose corrective actions

  • Build a pricing governance framework ensuring decisions are documented, consistent, and defensible




3. Promotional Governance & ROI Framework



  • Define promo guardrails and governance standards (frequency, depth, product eligibility, channel fit)

  • Build and maintain a promotional effectiveness tracking model — measuring actual ROI vs planned

  • Collaborate with countries to conduct pre- and post-promo analysis to identify what works, at what cost, and for which products

  • Work with Regional Category Managers to evaluate EU, APAC, and LATAM promo requests against global guardrails

  • Identify structural promo dependency risks (habituation, margin erosion, brand degradation) and escalate early

  • Partner with Finance and Commercial to ensure promo plans are margin-accretive or strategically justified




4. Competitive & Market Intelligence



  • Own and continuously maintain a structured competitive landscape view across Emma's core categories

  • Track competitor pricing, product launches, positioning changes, and promotional activity across key markets

  • Develop a repeatable, scalable competitive intelligence process — pulling from multiple sources (online scraping, trade press, field reports, mystery shopping)

  • Analyse market sizing, category growth rates, and channel shifts to identify whitespace and strategic risks

  • Deliver regular competitive intelligence reports and ad-hoc briefs when significant competitor moves occur

  • Support business case modelling with validated market data and external benchmarks




5. Category Decision Support & Business Cases



  • Serve as the analytical partner to Global and Regional Category Managers — providing the data backbone for strategic decisions

  • Build and validate business cases for new product investments, portfolio changes, and category expansion

  • Support market sizing exercises, opportunity assessments, and go/no-go frameworks for innovation

  • Work with Finance to translate category insights into P&L impact, investment return projections, and budget inputs

  • Develop self-service analytics tools and templates that help the broader category team make faster, better decisions





Who we are looking for:

  • 4–6 years in pricing, strategy, business analytics, revenue management, or category performance in a consumer goods, DTC, e-commerce, or retail context

  • Proven experience designing or operating pricing frameworks and governance processes

  • Experience working with BI tools and building performance dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent)

  • Experience using statistics and data science to inform business and commercial decisions

  • Experience with competitive intelligence and market analysis methodologies

  • Background in building business cases and financial models for portfolio or pricing decisions

  • Highly analytical and data-literate: you are comfortable in Excel and BI tools, and can build models independently

  • Solid foundation in statistics (hypothesis testing, regression basics, distributions, interpreting outputs) and clear understanding of clustering methods (e.g., k-means) and their practical limitations

  • Working knowledge of Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, basic scripting, data cleaning, exploratory analysis)

  • Track record of translating complex data into clear, decision-ready business recommendations

  • Pricing-first thinker: you understand the interplay between pricing, perceived value, volume, and margin

  • Structured and rigorous: you build frameworks that hold up under scrutiny and can be used repeatedly

  • Business-oriented: you translate insights into decisions, not just reports

  • Strong communicator: able to present complex analytical findings clearly to non-analytical audiences including leadership

  • Collaborative: you work as a service partner to category managers — empowering their decisions, not replacing them

  • Proactive: you spot issues and opportunities before being asked, and you come with solutions




What we offer:

  • At Emma, you’ll find a culture of freedom, impact, and zero politics. We give you full ownership from day one and expect you to move fast, think big, and grow even faster. 

  • Pet-friendly environment, where you can bring your furry desk buddy;  

  • Discounts on our top-notch products;   

  • Health insurance including dentist;  

  • 24 days holidays/year +1 day/year at Emma (max. 29 days);  

  • The opportunity to collaborate with multinational teams;  

  • Exciting events that aren't just team-building exercises but opportunities to create epic memories







Become an Emmie 



We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  




We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 




Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Senior Data Modeller
Description:
YOUR ROLE

You will lead a modelling strategy for scientific data harmonization work. This work aims to strengthen mechanistic understanding of disease and make integrated FAIR data products available to R&D scientists for rapid query and decision-making. You turn ambiguous scientific requirements into clear canonical models, make and document ontology decisions, and set the standards for identifiers, provenance and schema governance across data assets.


Lead modelling strategy across data harmonization, pipeline validation, knowledge graph and FAIR data product requirements
Translate ambiguous scientific requirements into clear conceptual, logical and canonical data models
Model biomedical entities and relationships including genes, targets, diseases, indications, phenotypes, mechanisms, biomarkers, tissues, cell types, assay modalities, evidence, provenance and causal relationships
Make ontology reuse, extension and mapping decisions, with documented rationale
Define persistent identifiers and consistent provenance fields across data assets
Drive schema review, approval, versioning and publication processes in GitHub, including changelogs, tagged releases and downstream impact assessment
Define validation rules and data quality checks for ontology terms, ranges, required fields, ID and label consistency, cross-field consistency and provenance completeness
Identify modelling risks early: metadata gaps, ontology conflicts, source data quality issues, lineage gaps and downstream compatibility problems
Design modular, reusable and future-proof models aligned to FAIR principles and enterprise standards
Work with scientific knowledge engineering, biology SMEs, data engineering, knowledge graph engineering, product management, data stewards and platform teams
Mentor junior and mid-level modelers


YOUR PROFILE


MSc or PhD (or equivalent professional experience) in biology, biomedical sciences, bioengineering, genetics, neuroscience, bioinformatics, computational biology or a related field
More than 6 years of experience in scientific or biomedical data modelling, data harmonization or knowledge engineering, with senior ownership
Strong conceptual, logical and canonical modelling experience for complex biomedical or scientific domains
Practical, in-depth experience with LinkML or an equivalent schema framework: classes, slots, ranges, identifiers, required fields, constraints, cardinality, descriptions and ontology bindings
Strong data harmonization experience: source-to-canonical mapping, controlled vocabulary alignment, persistent identifiers, lineage and provenance
Proven experience defining validation rules and data quality checks: ontology term validity, ranges, required fields, ID and label consistency, cross-field consistency and provenance completeness
Strong understanding of FAIR principles, metadata standards, provenance and schema versioning
Strong command of biomedical ontologies and vocabularies such as HGNC, Ensembl, UniProt, MONDO, Disease Ontology, HPO, EFO, UBERON, Cell Ontology, Gene Ontology, Reactome, KEGG, ChEBI, OBI, LOINC, UCUM, ECO, SEPIO, Relation Ontology and PATO
Experience managing the schema lifecycle with GitHub-based repositories, semantic versioning, changelogs, data dictionaries and metadata catalogues
Experience designing models that support pipelines, APIs, knowledge graphs, FAIR data products and analytical workflows
Solid Python and a working command of SQL, used for validation, mapping checks and exploration of real biomedical datasets
A public or shareable repository (GitHub, GitLab or similar) demonstrating schema and governance work. Please include the link in your application
Excellent stakeholder management and communication;
Fluent English


Preferred Qualifications


Semantic modelling technologies: RDF, OWL, JSON-LD, SHACL, ShEx and SPARQL; knowledge graph modelling
Schema or model registry, data catalogue and metadata registry tooling
Lineage and provenance modelling, and FAIR metadata assessment
Query-based validation using SQL or Python and notebooks for model conformance, ontology mapping or data quality checks
Agentic AI or LLM-assisted mapping and curation, with robust validation
Experience in pharmaceutical R&D or another regulated research environment
Cloud platforms, Docker and workflow orchestration
Applied machine learning and/or broad data science
Experience mentoring or leading a small technical team
Scientific curiosity paired with engineering discipline
Critical thinking and attention to data provenance and quality
Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to move between scientific meaning and technical implementation
An impact-driven mindset in a fast-paced environment
Portuguese fluency


What You´ll Love About Working Here


Join a multicultural and inclusive team environment.
Enjoy a supportive atmosphere promoting work life balance.
Hybrid work.
Your career growth is central to our mission. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professionals are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Access valuable training and certifications in cutting edge technologies.
Engage in exciting national and international projects.
Health and life insurance.
Referral program with bonuses for talent recommendations.
Great office locations.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries.

Title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
Description:
Job Description

About the Team:

The Requirements Portal delivers essential features on the Altium Develop/Agile platform for engineering teams to collaborate on their product requirements. It covers the entire lifecycle from importing with smart importers customer requirements, collaborating on them, connecting them to the electronics design, verifying them and creating relevant compliance documents.


Shape the future: You'll be part of a close-knit team with ambitious goals, but you'll also have the freedom and power to define the best way to achieve them. Collaborate with your team to map out the features and technical path that will bring our product vision to life;
Grow together, share knowledge: We foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing. You'll have the opportunity to learn from and mentor your teammates, contributing to a collaborative environment where everyone thrives;


If you like the idea of working in an environment that encourages creative and autonomous work, focuses on your growth potential and where there’s always room to discuss the quirks of living on this planet, then we might just be a perfect fit.

About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our team working at the frontier of applied AI in Requirements Management and Hardware Engineering more in general.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll help build and evaluate real-world AI applications with immediate commercial impact. You’ll help design, develop, and deploy LLM-driven systems used by hardware product teams around the world, while learning how AI projects move from idea to production inside a product-led development team in the age of Agentic Hardware Engineering.

A day in the life of our Senior AI Engineer


Develop agentic flows using off-the-shelf LLMs and applying modern harnessing methods (tool-calling, planning, skills, sub-agents, mcp servers, CLIs, etc.) to hardware design/requirement management use-cases.
Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and designers in an agile, sprint-based environment to ship features and improvements
Build evaluation pipelines, design metrics and gather data to measure and improve the performance of AI-driven systems.
Extend test-suite, refining and running benchmarks on our AI systems.
Benchmark models, prompts and approaches for speed, cost and accuracy and improve results methodically using techniques with highest impact (meta prompting, fine tuning, RAG, caching, prompt compression, distillation, etc.)
Participating in the full AI product lifecycle: from early-stage experimentation to deployment and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

Essential skills:


Profound knowledge of LLM engineering and how LLM-based features are built and evaluated in production-ready environments
Advanced Python development skills to implement such systems
Production Experience with:
Agentic loops
Tool-calling
Agent orchestration
MCP servers
Evaluation and benchmarking pipelines.
Cost and latency optimization (context compression/model cascading etc)
Ability to plan experiments and execute tasks autonomously with an eye for detail
Quick learner to understand and keep up with the constantly evolving AI landscape
Experience in working in multi disciplinary teams to ship features to customers
Curiosity for user journeys and real-world use cases to validate solutions

Nice To Have


Production experience with:
Synthetic test data creation
Distillation
Agent Orchestration Debugging
Finetuning models
Experience with (hardware) engineering software
Experience with developing end-to-end harnesses for agentic loops
Experience with building high concurrency asynchronous services
Experience with stateful agentic frameworks (like LangGraph)

Additional Information

🏥 Private Health Insurance (Allianz) – Altium covers 100% of the health insurance cost for employees. Coverage can be extended to family members (spouse/partner and children).

🥗 Meal Allowance – Paid via a prepaid meal card, providing the maximum tax-exempt daily amount for each working day.

🌍 Remote Working Abroad Program – This program enables eligible employees to apply to work from a country outside of their country of employment for up to 30 business days in a rolling 12-month period.

🎓 Professional Development Grant – Financial assistance is available for professional development programs, reimbursed after the course is successfully completed with a passing grade or certification.

📚 Learning Resources – Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning and the company intranet talent portal, hosting essential skills training and digital learning platforms.

🧠 Mental Health Benefit (nilo.health) – Access to a mental well-being platform providing one-to-one sessions with certified psychologists and expert-backed digital tools.

🌴 Time Off – 22 vacation days per calendar year (for full-time employees) and a shortened work schedule on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve (finishing at 12:30 p.m.).

🍏 Office Comforts – Ergonomic workplaces, fresh fruits, snacks, free coffee and drinks, and a rooftop terrace for your comfort.

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Who We Are

ABOUT ENOVIS™

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.

As suas responsabilidades | What You'll Do

At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence, with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

As a key member of the Global Digital Center of Excellence, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward by transforming digital data into actionable insights, strengthening performance measurement, and enabling smarter, data-driven decisions across our global digital ecosystem.

Job Title

Digital Performance & Analytics Lead

Reports To

Head of Global Digital CoE

Location:

Lisbon, Portugal – Hybrid

Business Unit Description

Global Digital Center of Excellence – Data, Analytics & Insights

Job Title/High-Level Position Summary

The Digital Performance & Analytics Lead establishes a standardized measurement framework that provides objective visibility into traffic, conversion, lead generation, and overall digital performance across Enovis' businesses.

Working within the Global Digital Center of Excellence, and in the spirit of the Enovis Growth Excellence (EGX) continuous-improvement culture, the role will create a single source of truth for digital performance, transforming fragmented reporting into shared, actionable insights that drive investment, prioritization, and optimization decisions.

This role will work across brands, regions, and digital properties, partnering with business units, Digital CoE teams, IT, and external partners to establish consistent performance standards and strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Define and implement the KPI framework, dashboards, and performance reporting for the global digital ecosystem.
Generate actionable insights across conversion, growth, lead generation, traffic, and overall digital performance to inform prioritization and optimization decisions.
Establish governance standards for attribution, reporting quality, and data consistency.
Partner with business unit and Digital CoE teams to translate complex data into clear business insights, decisions, and measurable actions.
Apply consistent measurement and reporting standards across brands, regions, and digital properties.
Support investment and optimization decisions through objective, comparable performance data.
Improve visibility into digital performance and ROI, helping teams understand where investment and optimization efforts can deliver the greatest impact.
Promote a strong data-driven and continuous-improvement culture across the global digital ecosystem.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Basic Qualifications


Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital analytics, measurement, and performance reporting.
Demonstrated experience defining KPI frameworks and driving data governance within a multi-stakeholder environment.
Strong command of analytics platforms, dashboards, and attribution methodologies.
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics or an equivalent web analytics platform.
Experience with marketing attribution tools and methodologies.
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Excellent communication skills; English required.
Microsoft Office proficiency required.


Desired Characteristics


Experience with web and eCommerce analytics and tag management.
Experience working within global or multi-brand digital ecosystems.
Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and data integration.
Strong analytical mindset combined with the ability to translate data into a compelling business story.
Excellent ability to communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business-impact and results orientation.
Ability to work effectively across business units, Digital CoE teams, IT, and external partners.
Curious, proactive, and insight-driven mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities beyond standard reporting.
Strong focus on continuous improvement, data quality, and measurable business outcomes.


What Success Looks Like


Digital performance dashboards are widely adopted, with KPIs consistently applied across business units.
Increased ability to translate insights into clear actions and optimization opportunities.
Improved visibility into conversion performance, traffic, lead generation, and digital growth.
Stronger data and performance discipline across Enovis' global digital ecosystem.
Clearer and more consistent measurement of digital ROI.
Reliable performance data that enables informed decisions around digital investments and optimization.
A trusted, standardized single source of truth for digital performance across brands and regions.


Travel Requirements


Must be able to travel up to 10% of the time, including both domestic and international travel.
Typical work-related travel assignments range from 1–3 days and may require overnight, out-of-town stays.
This role operates within a hybrid working arrangement based in Lisbon, Portugal.


Creating Better Together

“Creating better together.” It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale.

We know that the power to create better, for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders, begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes.

What does creating better together mean to us at Enovis? Discover the “why” behind our purpose, values and behaviors.

Join us in creating better together.

Even though we are relatively unknown to the general public, at SDG we work for half of the IBEX-35 groups and other international companies. Thanks to the analytics boom, we are growing steadily and have been helping our clients understand and analyse their data since 1994.




What makes us different? 🧐

In our projects, data and technology are the leaders, we will train you to be able to work with the latest in the market (we have an innovation area where we promote new partnerships with technology manufacturers and R&D centers).
You will have all the opportunities to develop your best self, with a completely customized career plan in which you will learn on your own and also have the support of your colleagues. You will set your own time, you will talk to your manager every six months to share feedback and new challenges, and based on your results, there will be a salary review.
We are a big family, from the first moment we will try to make your life easier. Your colleagues and the rest of the team will always have a smile on their faces and will be ready to help and support you.
You will collaborate and work on a daily basis with great references (technical and/or business), they will be happy to teach you as much as possible and will be proud to see you grow.
Smartwork is possible with us. You will experience a way of working where everyone manages their own time.
We are a brand with purpose. We believe that diversity and inclusion help promote a culture of creativity, allowing us to overcome new situations and challenges as an organization committed to people and society.
Getting into more formal matters, but not less important, we offer a permanent contract, we want you to stay with us for a long time! A competitive salary according to your level of training and experience (don't worry, we will discuss this aspect in the first interview and inform you if your expectations are aligned).




We could go on and on about what makes us special, and we'd love to do it in a phone call. For now, let's show you some details that we're sure you'll find interesting 👇🏼







What will be your mission? ✍

Analysis, design and development of solutions and projects in the field of data engineering in Business Intelligence.
Data processing and development of ETL processes.
Creation and modeling of Data Marts in relational, dimensional and/or table environments.
Build and maintain positive relationships with client staff at all levels;
Be updated on the latest technological trends in the field of Analytics.







What will make you succeed in this position? 👇

Bachelor/Master in a field that emphasizes data analysis (Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, Engineering or Statistics).
Experience over 5 years in the field of Analytics, ideally in service/consulting companies.
Experience using Azure Databricks for data processing and analysis.
Proficiency in Python programming and SQL Server.
Innovative spirit with balanced customer, business and technology orientation.
Interest in challenges, commitment, integrity, maturity, ability to work as a team and a high sense of responsibility.
Fluent level of English.







Finally, we would like to tell you about the stages of our selection process.




In Our Processes You Will Do 3️ Meetings

First contact with our People First area (where we will discuss professional growth, salary band and define which areas suit you).
Second technical session where you can surprise us with all your knowledge and skills in technological environments (so we can offer you a project that matches your knowledge and interests).
Meeting with the person in charge of the team you will be joining in order to solve any doubts that may have emerged during the process.







If you have passed all the phases, good news! You will receive a call from People First where we will present our offer for you to join us, and we will be able to answer any questions you may have. When you confirm that you want to be part of the SDG family, we will start preparing everything to welcome you with great enthusiasm.




You can't join us now, but you are interested in SDG Group? Don't worry, you can go through the selection process now and we will consider you for the next job opportunities that match your professional profile.




JOIN NOW, WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Title: Senior Internal Auditor - Data Analytics (SQL/Python)
Description:
Job Type

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

The team

The Group Internal Audit team provides independent and objective assurance and advice to the Group Audit Committee, and to the Boards of Directors of the companies within the Group, over the processes and systems of control and risk management operating in the Group. Its scope covers all aspects of the Group and its activities. It also liaises closely with other monitoring functions across the Group, including Group Compliance and Group Risk. Its Audit Plans are developed using a risk-based approach.

The Vision for the Group Internal Audit team is ‘To be recognised as a leading edge audit function among its peer group, which provides robust assurance and value creating insight and challenge through the excellence of its people, processes and technology’. The purpose of this Vision is to provide a consistent point of reference for our development. Our day to day work and any changes we make to what we do must be consistent with and contribute to this Vision.

The Group Audit team is based across three hubs in the UK (London and York), Europe (Lisbon and Luxembourg) and US (Atlanta and White Plains). The team is supplemented with additional co-source when required.

Professional standards

Our work adheres to the Institute of Internal Auditors’ (IIA) mandatory guidance including the Definition of Internal Auditing, the Code of Ethics and the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (‘the Standards’). We also adhere to guidance issued by the Chartered Institute of Internal Auditors in the UK (CIIA): Effective Internal Audit in the Financial Services Sector.

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a small but dynamic team, you will conduct internal audits across the Hiscox Group in line with the Audit Plan. These audits will be aligned to all Hiscox Business Units and Group functions. This will be through working with other members of the team, alone on some reviews or with co-source.

The role covers all aspects of the successful delivery of audits, including:


design and execute data-driven audit procedures (e.g. transaction analysis, anomaly detection) and support the development and delivery of the data analytics and AI strategy within the Internal Audit team.
ensuring the successful and timely completion of reviews, from initial scoping and planning through to reporting and follow up of actions and recommendations. You could take on the lead role on several audits, responsible for their end to end delivery, as well as supporting other team members with their audits;
extract, clean and analyse large datasets (SQL, Python)
build reusable analytics tools and scripts
translate technical outputs into clear audit insights for senior stakeholder
making effective and pragmatic recommendations to address issues and to add value to the business;
working with and supporting other team members;
contributing to Internal Audit’s planning and strategy, and to its continued development. You will lead the development and / or implementation of certain assigned aspects of this non-audit related work; and
helping to build and maintain Internal Audit’s presence and reputation across the Group.



Outside the Audit Plan, you may be asked to conduct specific reviews or to take on special projects. You will also be expected to take on additional responsibilities to support the Group Chief Auditor and other team members as required.

The primary reporting line will be to an Audit Director based in Luxembourg.

Specification


Preferably degree qualified in accountancy, computer science, information systems, data science, mathematics or a similar discipline, with a relevant professional accountancy, audit or other professional certification.
Previous internal audit experience (risk or consultancy experience would also be considered for exceptional candidates), which ideally would be gained within insurance
Data extraction and analysis capability, ideally with experience data analytic tooling (e.g. Tableau, SQL, PowerBI, Alteryx, Python)
Experience with AI, machine learning and emerging technologies are an advantage
Experience in continuous auditing, monitoring and automation
Fluent in English
A dynamic, assertive and self-confident individual who can deliver without the need for high levels of supervision
The ability to plan and organise an end to end audit with minimal day to day supervision, audit with the inherent flexibility to adapt the process as required
The ability to translate audit objectives, risks and controls into defensible, repeatable analytics to support audit conclusions
Independent worker, resilient and self-reliant. Must also be confident delivering difficult messages to senior stakeholders and be comfortable drafting written reports (which will be shared at Group Committee and Board level)
Strong people and relationship building skills, notably influencing and negotiating
Sound audit judgement
Excellent team working skills and the ability to supervise and coach other team members constructively and effectively
Experience in business intelligence and data visualisation
Innovative problem solving skills and the courage to apply them
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
Good commercial awareness



Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
Description:
Tem uma forte capacidade analítica, interesse pelo negócio e gosta de transformar dados em decisões comerciais? Gostaria de desempenhar um papel central no suporte às equipas de Vendas e Marketing numa empresa líder de mercado? Então esta oportunidade poderá ser para si.

A Empresa

A Coloplast é uma multinacional dinamarquesa que desenvolve e comercializa dispositivos médicos e produtos de saúde para diversas áreas terapêuticas. A nossa elevada quota de mercado e crescimento sustentado resultam da capacidade de oferecer soluções inovadoras e do elevado nível dos nossos profissionais.

A Posição

Esta é uma posição-chave para o sucesso comercial da subsidiária portuguesa, transformando dados em insights acionáveis e apoiando decisões estratégicas que impulsionam o crescimento do negócio.

A principal missão da função é fornecer informação e análises baseadas em factos para aumentar o desempenho das vendas, a produtividade e a excelência da execução comercial. Será necessária uma excelente capacidade analítica e aptidão para sintetizar grandes volumes de informação, transformando-os em formatos de fácil compreensão para os departamentos de Marketing e Vendas. A função reporta diretamente à Country Manager e integra o planeamento anual e os principais projetos comerciais e estratégicos da organização.

Principais Responsabilidades


Análise de dados: gestão e análise de dados de vendas sell-in e sell-out. Responsável pela relação com a hmR e pela gestão do contrato anual.
Segmentação, Targeting e Compliance: desenvolver e manter modelos de segmentação e definição de clientes prioritários, garantindo a eficiência da estratégia de visitas.
Manutenção do CRM (Salesforce): garantir a qualidade, integridade e completude dos dados, incluindo a área de negócio de consumo.
Pricing e gestão de grossistas: apoiar análises de preços e a gestão de armazenistas e grossistas farmacêuticos.
Suporte analítico à organização: desenvolver análises ad hoc e assegurar a qualidade das ferramentas analíticas e ficheiros Excel.
Apoio à gestão: suportar a equipa de liderança através de análises e recomendações estratégicas.




Perfil Procurado


Mentalidade analítica com forte orientação comercial.
Excelentes competências interpessoais e de comunicação.
Utilizador avançado de Excel; conhecimentos de Power BI serão valorizados.
Experiência com Salesforce ou outro sistema de CRM será considerada uma mais-valia.
Experiência mínima de 2 anos numa função analítica e/ou comercial.
Elevada atenção ao detalhe e rigor analítico.
Capacidade para comunicar conclusões complexas de forma simples e clara.
Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua.
Fluência em português e inglês.




O Que Oferecemos

Integração numa empresa multinacional líder, com formação inicial e contínua, exposição a projetos estratégicos, ambiente internacional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

Com uma agenda de crescimento ambiciosa, a Coloplast desenvolve e comercializa produtos e serviços que facilitam a vida de pessoas com necessidades íntimas de saúde. Emprega cerca de 16.000 pessoas e com produtos disponíveis em mais de 143 países, somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais em dispositivos médicos. Estamos em constante crescimento e sempre à procura de novas formas de avançar – exploramos, aprendemos e procuramos novas formas de fazer as coisas.

A Coloplast está comprometida em ser uma organização inclusiva, onde as pessoas trazem suas diferenças para o trabalho todos os dias, realizam o seu potencial e têm uma forte sensação de pertença porque – e não apesar – das suas diferenças. Portanto, incentivamos todos os candidatos qualificados a se inscreverem, independentemente do gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade, etnia, orientação sexual, crença religiosa ou capacidade física.

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Portugal
Description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.




With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.




We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.







We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to design, maintain, and evolve data models that power business intelligence and analytical solutions. In this role, you will own the layered dbt data model, enabling reliable data consumption across Power BI and downstream applications.




You will play a key role in supporting the development of a pricing engine, enhancing item categorization and price elasticity analysis, and harmonizing KPIs across regions to establish a consistent, data-driven pricing methodology.


Responsibilities



Own and evolve the layered dbt data model, ensuring reliable, consistent, and well-structured data for Power BI and downstream consumers


Develop and maintain data transformation workflows using dbt and SQL, following best practices for modularity, testing, documentation, and maintainability


Extend existing data models to support the pricing engine MVP, including item categorization and price elasticity analysis


Harmonize business KPIs across regions, ensuring consistent definitions and calculations to support a common pricing methodology


Build and optimize analytical data solutions using Databricks and Azure


Apply Python where needed to support data processing, analysis, and automation


Develop and maintain data models for Power BI, enabling accurate reporting and effective business insights


Ensure data quality, consistency, and usability across analytical models and downstream applications


Collaborate with business stakeholders, data teams, and regional teams to translate analytical requirements into scalable data solutions


Contribute to continuous improvements in data architecture, modeling practices, and analytics engineering standards




Requirements for this challenge



Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related data-focused role


Advanced proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with dbt


Experience designing and maintaining layered data models for analytics and business intelligence


Experience with Databricks and Azure data environments


Proficiency in Python for data processing, analysis, or automation


Experience with Power BI, particularly data modeling and preparing data for reporting and analytics


Strong understanding of data quality, data validation, and consistent metric definitions


Ability to translate business requirements into robust, reusable data models


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data accuracy


Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with stakeholders across different regions




Nice to Have



Experience supporting pricing, revenue optimization, or commercial analytics initiatives


Knowledge of price elasticity, product categorization, and pricing performance metrics


Experience harmonizing KPIs and business definitions across regions or markets


Familiarity with modern data architecture and scalable analytical data platforms


Experience with data testing, documentation, lineage, and governance practices


Ability to balance technical modeling decisions with business priorities and analytical needs















Why join us?




 




- Competitive Salary  




- Generous paid vacation days




- Generous sick time 




- 100% paid health & dental benefits starting day one 




- Annual profit-sharing distribution 




- Paid parental leave 




- Dedicated career advisor  




And so much more…




 




Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. 




We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer – ML Evaluation & Experiment Design
Description:
Anyone AI is recruiting experienced Machine Learning Engineers for a specialized project focused on reviewing and evaluating machine learning challenges used in AI model training and evaluation.

The work involves analyzing ML experiments, datasets, metrics, and pipelines to determine whether challenges are technically sound, reproducible, appropriately difficult, and genuinely require strong machine learning reasoning.

What You’ll Work On

You’ll review ML challenges involving:


Experiment design and model selection
Small and synthetic datasets
Data quality and preprocessing
Distribution shift and data contamination
Label noise and feature leakage
Model evaluation and metric selection
Hyperparameter tuning
Train / validation / test methodology
Reproducibility and deterministic pipelines
Statistical significance of model improvements


A key part of the role is determining whether a challenge actually rewards good ML reasoning, rather than simply being solvable through brute-force model selection or large hyperparameter searches.

What We’re Looking For


3+ years of hands-on applied machine learning experience
Strong experience with:
ML experiment design
Model selection
Hyperparameter tuning
Model evaluation
Data preprocessing and validation
Strong understanding of train, validation, and test splits
Ability to identify:
Data leakage
Label noise
Distribution shift
Spurious correlations
Feature leakage
Data contamination
Experience evaluating whether performance improvements are statistically meaningful rather than random fluctuations
Strong understanding of ML evaluation metrics and when different metrics are appropriate
Experience debugging ML workloads across CPU and GPU environments
Ability to analyze technical problems and provide clear written feedback


Nice to Have


Experience creating or participating in Kaggle, DrivenData, or similar ML competitions
Experience designing benchmark datasets or ML challenges
Background in data-centric AI or dataset quality
Experience with synthetic data generation and validation
Familiarity with statistical testing, confidence intervals, and effect sizes
Experience with ML evaluation pipelines, RLHF, or AI model evaluation
Experience developing ML curricula or technical assessments
Understanding of common ML failure modes such as:
Shortcut learning
Spurious correlations
Goodhart’s Law
Simpson’s paradox
Metric gaming

What You’ll Be Responsible For


Reviewing ML challenges and determining whether they are well designed and technically solvable
Evaluating whether datasets contain meaningful and learnable signals
Identifying unintended shortcuts or artifacts in synthetic datasets
Determining whether tasks require genuine diagnosis of the underlying ML problem
Reviewing evaluation metrics and improvement thresholds
Detecting metric gaming, data leakage, and evaluation flaws
Verifying reproducibility across the complete data → model → evaluation pipeline
Assessing whether challenge difficulty is appropriately calibrated
Providing clear recommendations for improving, recalibrating, or excluding problematic tasks


Engagement

Work Type: Remote

Engagement: Part-time, project-based consulting

Focus: Applied machine learning, experiment design, data quality, and model evaluation

This role is a strong fit for ML engineers who enjoy debugging experiments, understanding why models succeed or fail, identifying problems in datasets and evaluation pipelines, and designing rigorous machine learning experiments.

Title: Applied Machine Learning Scientist
Description:
Job Description

The Enterprise Machine Learning team drives organizational value through scalable ML solutions and data-driven insights, fundamentally changing how business decisions are made. We collaborate closely with stakeholders, applying the latest advances in machine learning and statistical modeling to create highly impactful outcomes. Our commitment is to advance the state of applied science and robust system design to enhance and expand our core business capabilities.

Role Overview

We've spent the past year consolidating and validating our revenue data, most signals now live in one place. The next step is building a customer intelligence layer: systems that dynamically learn which signals drive outcomes, adapt as the business evolves, and surface insights that change how we act.

As an Applied Machine Learning Scientist, you will be the person who makes that happen. You will train models, design experiments, and uncover the patterns that connect customer behavior to revenue outcomes.Then ship those insights as production systems that the business relies on daily. You own problems end-to-end: from formulating the right question, to training and validating models, to deploying them and measuring whether they actually moved the needle, in a closed feedback loop.

You will work alongside a team of AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analysts as part of the Enterprise Data & Analytics department. Your focus is the science: understanding what drives outcomes, building models that learn from data, and turning that understanding into systems that work.

Key Responsibilities


Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models that predict and explain revenue-related outcomes, including churn, expansion, conversion, and customer engagement.
Build and own end-to-end ML systems, from data preparation and experimentation through production deployment, continuous retraining, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Develop intelligence from structured and unstructured data, applying statistical modeling, modern NLP, embeddings, LLMs, and deep learning where they create measurable business value.
Design and run experiments to uncover the relationships between customer behavior, product usage, and business outcomes, translating model outputs into actionable insights.

Lead the design and delivery of advanced AI, machine learning, and analytics solutions across the business.

- Senior Data Scientist

Mobility business unit is evolving how it creates value for its clients, and this role is at the heart of that change. You will be one of the senior people responsible for delivering data and AI solutions to clients. You'll take them from the initial idea, through development and deployment, to measuring and realising their value.

This is more than a data science role. Beyond building models, you will make sure solutions are reliable, coherent and production-ready, so they can be deployed and run with confidence at client sites. Project management stays with the project lead. You will be the technical and methodological reference on the project, and you'll have a real say in how it's delivered.

How you'll get started

You won't be doing this alone. You'll first join a dedicated innovation team, working alongside experienced practitioners who are building similar solutions. You'll be coached while you deliver your first projects, and you'll build the practices and confidence to lead on your own. After that, you'll move fully into the Mobility team as a senior delivery reference.




What We Are Looking For

Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience; certifications in AI/ML or data science are an advantage
3+ years of experience in data science or machine learning roles
Solid knowledge of Python and SQL, and experience with common ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Proven experience taking solutions from prototype to production
Experience with, or a strong drive to learn, the engineering side of delivery: cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), MLOps and building reliable platforms
Comfortable working directly with clients and taking ownership of what you deliver
Strong problem-solving mindset and a hands-on approach
Able to communicate complex insights clearly to business audiences and influence decisions
Interest in shaping how solutions and projects are built, not just executing them




What you'll do

Design, build and deploy data and AI solutions that address real client challenges in the Mobility space
Make sure solutions are robust, scalable and ready for production, not just proofs of concept
Contribute to defining project methodology, including scoping, success metrics, delivery phases and best practices for data and ML workflows
Guide the project team on technical and methodological choices and give the project lead input on approach, priorities and risks
Work closely with engineers, analysts, clients and business stakeholders to turn needs into practical solutions
Track and communicate the value your solutions deliver
Share knowledge with the team and help raise the bar on how we work with data and AI




Nice to have

Experience in the mobility, transport or automotive sector
Familiarity with generative AI and LLM-based solutions

Visualize data and results to communicate findings effectively

Implement and optimize machine learning algorithms using Python and relevant frameworks

Document methodologies, experiments, and results

Contribute to team discussions and planning sessions

Gradually expand expertise across different ML domains, like Causal ML

Intermediate knowledge in Scikit-Learn, Streamlit, Seaborn, Numpy, Pandas, SQL, Plotly and StatsModel and Python

Qualifications


Master’s degree (preferred) in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering.

Advanced knowledge in mathematics and Statistics
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Grow with purpose. We invest in our people by creating opportunities to build skills, take on new challenges, and develop over time.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Commodity Trading and Risk Management
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, mental health, and vision coverage for you, your spouse/partner, and children.


Your Impact

You will leverage your creativity and problem-solving skills to tackle clients’ most pressing issues using an analytical lens, meeting client needs and communicating your work to executive audiences.

Client counterparts span a wide range of audiences and functions from treasury and risk professionals, marketing & sales teams, procurement category managers, to high-level stakeholders (e.g., CFO). When working internally, you will build innovative algorithms and products (what we call “IP development”) to best meet our most common client needs, from building price forecasting models for commodities markets, to brainstorming and developing new offers and solutions to support future clients. You will also work with our engineers to design new interfaces to deliver faster, more impactful insights to our clients.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Shiny & Pharma Specialist
Description:
The Shiny lead who turns pharma analytics into actionable apps.




About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics. This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you. Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.




About the role

You will lead the design and delivery of Shiny-based analytics applications for pharma clients, acting as the technical lead on projects and coordinating across developers, data engineers and client stakeholders. You will apply SAGE methodology to structure analytics work, provide senior-level technical support for complex application issues when needed, and ensure outputs map to client needs and commercial value.




Skills and experience




Core Technical Skills

Design, build and optimise Shiny applications that integrate with APIs and demonstrate end-to-end app performance considerations, including data modelling such as star schema.
Produce high-quality, documented SQL and R code with unit tests and reproducible setup, including developing, testing and maintaining reusable R packages for production use, and use containerisation and environment tools such as Docker and Windows Subsystem for Linux to package and distribute solutions.




Interpersonal Traits

Lead customer-facing technical discussions, present project progress and trade-offs to stakeholders, and explain technical risks clearly to non-technical audiences.
Builds strong user relationships by listening carefully to feedback, clarifying needs and communicating progress and outcomes clearly.
Mentor and review colleagues’ work by providing clear, actionable technical feedback and supporting onboarding to develop team capability.
Engage in agile ceremonies and contribute to architectural discussions, driving adoption of good practices and pragmatic technical decisions across the team.




Pharma Experience

Operate in the tech lead role on pharma engagements, coordinating delivery and making decisions that reflect pharma project constraints.
Apply SAGE methodology to structure analytics workstreams and ensure outputs align with client expectations in pharma projects.




Nice to Have

Core Data Science Skills such as; applying statistical rigour and machine learning methods, including designing A/B testing frameworks using frequentist and Bayesian approaches.
Experience using established Shiny development frameworks, such as golem or Rhino, to build structured, maintainable and production-ready applications.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with the ability to use these technologies to create and enhance interactive visualisations and improve the user experience of Shiny applications.
Experience using the data.table R package to efficiently manipulate, transform and analyse large or complex datasets.




What you will do

Lead delivery of Shiny-based analytics projects for pharma accounts, coordinating cross-functional teams to meet defined success criteria and timelines.
Support user testing by gathering customer feedback on applications, translating it into clear technical requirements, implementing fixes and communicating outcomes back to users.
Advise clients on technical solution design and identify capability or capacity gaps that shape the account approach and opportunity discovery.
Plan and estimate technical delivery work, supporting project management with realistic technical scope, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
Own key deliverables end-to-end, including defining success metrics, performing quality control and presenting outputs that link analytics work to commercial impact.
Contribute to internal assets, proofs-of-concept and accelerators to scale our Shiny and analytics offerings across accounts.
Drive reductions in technical debt by proposing pragmatic trade-offs, prioritising fixes that restore service, and defining repayment plans to improve long-term stability.




Why join us

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.

Title: Data Scientist – ML Engineer
Description:
Are you a Data Scientist passionate about building cutting-edge AI/ML solutions? Do you thrive on solving complex problems and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI? If yes, we want you on our dynamic and innovative team! With over 3 years of hands-on experience, you'll lead the way in developing and optimizing state-of-the-art AI algorithms, including Generative AI models.

Why You’ll Love This Role:


Work at the forefront of AI and machine learning innovation in a big European financial group.
Collaborate with experts in data science, AI, and product development.
Build impactful solutions that solve real-world challenges.


What You’ll Do:


Design & Deploy: Create machine learning models and tailored AI solutions.
Innovate: Fine-tune and extend Large Language Models (LLMs) including open-source and commercial models.
Optimize: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques for enhanced model efficiency.
Analyze: Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to unlock better model performance.
Build Generative AI: Develop cutting-edge models for content creation, process automation, and innovation.
Apply Traditional ML: Utilize decision trees, SVMs, neural networks, and more to solve diverse problems.
Collaborate: Work alongside data engineers, product managers, and stakeholders.
Quality Assurance: Ensure high-quality AI solutions through rigorous testing and validation.
Document & Share: Maintain technical documentation for knowledge sharing and reproducibility.


Your Must-Have Skills:


Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
3+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning and AI development.
Strong expertise in Generative AI (model training, fine-tuning, and deployment).
Experience with open-source and commercial LLMs.
Proficiency in implementing RAG techniques.
Experience with vector databases.
Advanced programming skills in Python with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face.
Deep understanding of NLP techniques and architectures.
Practical experience with traditional AI/ML methods such as decision trees, SVMs, clustering, and neural networks.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for AI/ML deployments.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and tools.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Effective communication in public and teamwork skills.
Fluency in English (C1 level or higher) is mandatory.
Willingness to learn French.


Nice-to-Have Skills:


Knowledge of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
Familiarity with prompt engineering.
Understanding of ethical AI principles and model interpretability.
Fluency in French is a plus.


Other Details:

This position is hybrid 2x in Parque das Nações/Lisbon.
