Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role Overview

This is a long-term fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.

What You Will Do


Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.


Who You Are


5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.


Nice-to-have


Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
DBT experience for analytics engineering.
Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.


Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Bring your unique talents and experience to a leading company in Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions. Grow your passion into a rewarding profession by joining a dynamic and expanding organization. You’ll play a vital role that supports your success and helps drive safe, efficient, and reliable operations across industries worldwide.

Where you’ll work: This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our engineers consistently tell us they value.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

You will own machine learning solutions end to end — from framing the business problem to running models reliably in production — built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors deployed around the world.

Collaborate for success


Own machine learning projects end to end: plan the roadmap, frame the problem, build the pipelines, and take solutions through to production.
Translate business goals into ML solutions, and explain results, limitations and uncertainty to business stakeholders in terms they can act on.
Make the technical decisions, contribute significantly to the implementation, and mentor other engineers through code review and design discussion. This is a hands-on role.


Build ML-powered solutions


Deliver forecasting, classification and anomaly detection on time series from industrial IoT sensors reporting in real time from sites across the globe.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, scarce labels, and a device population that keeps evolving.
Run what you build — monitoring, drift detection and retraining — and shape the data pipelines your models depend on.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on model risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any model whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across data engineering, machine learning and MLOps, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

Minimum Requirements -


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field or equivalent combination of education and experience
5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or a closely related software engineering role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred).
Hands-on experience delivering production-level, cloud-native machine learning solutions.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong understanding of feature engineering, ML algorithms, model training and evaluation.
Solid experience across a modern ML stack: gradient boosting (LightGBM, XGBoost), scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow, and current time series tooling.
Experience operating models in production: deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining, and a feel for the MLOps practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.


Preferred Qualifications -


Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, MLflow, streaming pipelines.
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar patterns for exposing models as tools other agents can call directly.
Domain experience in industrial, energy or IoT settings.

Supervisão e/ou participação em projetos de engenharia de dados, garantindo a entrega de soluções robustas e escaláveis
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de dados eficientes, para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados
Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares (analistas, cientistas de dados, arquitetos) em projetos com clientes de referência a nível nacional e internacional

Garantia do cumprimento de prazos e da qualidade na execução das suas entregas



És tu quem procuramos?


Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática, Computadores, Dados, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas
Experiência profissional entre 2 e 10 anos nas áreas da tecnologia ou engenharia, com foco em dados
Conhecimentos Técnicos:
SQL: Experiência em SQL, com conhecimento em bases de dados relacionais (ex. SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL ou equivalente)
ETL/ELT: Experiência em ferramentas de ETL de dados (ex. ADF, AWS Glue, SSIS, Pentaho, dbt ou equivalente).
Linguagens de Programação: Conhecimentos em Python,Scala ou Java.
CI/CD: Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD aplicadas ao ciclo de vida de dados
Data Modeling : Conhecimento em modelação de dados e boas práticas de design de bases de dados
Outros Conhecimentos que Valorizamos:
AI : Experiência com tecnologias de Generative AI (ex: OpenAI; Gemini; Claude, Cursor ou equivalente)
Big Data : Experiência com ferramentas de Big Data (ex. Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive)
Cloud Computing : Experiência em ambientes de Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS, GCP), com conhecimento de ferramentas de dados em cloud (ex. Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Singlestore)
Conhecimentos das metodologias ágeis (ex. Scrum, Kanban)
Obrigatória fluência em Português e Inglês, tanto escrito como falado, especialmente em contextos técnicos
Motivação e interesse para aprender e trabalhar com diferentes tecnologias
Orientação para o cliente e para resultados
Comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipa e colaboração
Resolução de problemas, capacidade analítica e espírito crítico
Organização, planeamento e orientação para a qualidade dos projetos

Num contexto de trabalho diverso que permite um desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos
Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos

Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências

Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas
Uma oportunidade para fazeres parte das nossas comunidades (de Tech, inovação, desporto e outros interesses) e para participares ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social.

A área de Technology & Transformation de AI&Data, atua em projetos da indústria de Fi nancial Services para o mercado financeiro português e internacional. A principal tipologia de projetos são : Data Science ; Generative AI ; Cloud Data Architecture ; Data Engineering .

No que consistem estes projetos?


Data Science : Criação de modelos preditivos e análises avançadas para otimização de processos e tomada de decisão.
Generative AI : Desenvolvimento e aplicação de tecnologias de inteligência artificial para aumento de eficiência e melhorar serviços.
Cloud Data Architecture : Estruturação e gestão de dados em ambientes de cloud para garantir escalabilidade e segurança.
Data Engineering : Construção e manutenção de sistemas e pipelines de dados eficientes para suportar análises e operações de negócio.



A nossa missão é transformar dados em valor, ajudando os nossos clientes a prosperar num mundo cada vez mais orientado por dados.

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Terás a oportunidade de integrar diversos projetos de transformação e fazer parte de uma equipa que te vai inspirar e ajudar a desenvolver soluções diferenciadoras, num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde podes dar o melhor de ti e beneficiar das nossas iniciativas de bem-estar e flexibilidade. Title: Lead Data Consultant
Description:
Company Description

Hitachi Solutions Europe is a global Digital, Data and Technology consultancy, Microsoft Solution Partner and Cloud Services partner, specialising in end-to-end transformation.

As a global consultancy company working across the private and public sectors, we specialise in Dynamics 365 Business Applications, Power Platform, including Azure, Application Modernisation and Data & Analytics.

Our highly skilled team help drive improvements, creating efficiency and growth within organisations. We are committed to Microsoft technologies, with a mission to revolutionise modern businesses.

To achieve this we employ the best, most dedicated talent to deliver outstanding technology solutions to both our local and global clients.

Be part of our Hitachi family

We place value on collaboration, open communication, and transparency. We emphasise the importance of team spirit, cohesion, and appreciation. Through our talented people, innovative culture, and technical and business expertise, we deliver game changing outcomes every day. Our learning culture and flat hierarchy are our recipes for success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead Data Consultant to join us on our exciting journey and be part of our Hitachi Solutions family.

This is a unique and challenging opportunity for an experienced Analytics Consultant to join the Data, Analytics & AI practice of Hitachi Solutions Portugal.

In this role you will be providing bespoke and cutting-edge data and advanced analytics solutions, bringing significant commercial advantage to some of Europe’s most recognised companies.

The successful candidate will draw upon their experience with data engineering and business intelligence tools and techniques to advise clients on data and analytics best practices and deliver data and analytics solutions on time and to budget.

The Main Areas Of Responsibility Are


Provide expert advisory services to clients on advanced analytics and data engineering best practices, ensuring delivery of scalable and efficient solutions.
Lead teams and projects, supporting all aspects of delivery from requirements gathering to solution design and implementation.
Capture client requirements and lead the development of solution architectures that meet both current and future business needs.
Design and develop bespoke Data Platform, Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions, leveraging the latest cloud technologies.
Lead the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise data engineering solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks, delivering robust, secure, and scalable data products that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
Build and oversee the development of dynamic, interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, ensuring clear, actionable insights for clients.
Guide teams in data modelling and transformation efforts, ensuring the development of optimised data architectures, including the design of ETL/ELT pipelines.
Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their professional development.
Actively contribute to the development of the team in Portugal, ensuring close ties to the rest of the European team.


Qualifications

We are looking to hire ambitious consulting professionals who combine their technical acumen with a genuine enthusiasm for improving organisations:


10+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-based Data Engineering, Analytics, and AI solutions, ideally within a consulting or systems integration environment.
Extensive experience in a client-facing role, previously working for a consultancy or systems integrator, with a proven track record of leading teams or projects.
Hands-on experience with modern programming languages such as Python and SQL.
Familiarity with data integration tools like Azure Data Factory and Data platform solutions such as Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.
Expertise in data visualisation and analytics using Power BI, QlikView or Tableau.
Strong experience in data modelling and transformation, including the design of ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing solutions
Experience or awareness of Big Data and Data Science and/or AI technologies, including the integration of Machine Learning models and/or Generative AI components.
Experience in leading, mentoring, and developing Data & Analytics teams, with a passion for coaching and growing talent.
Demonstrated leadership within the Data Engineering and AI domain, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and client management skills.


Additional Information

Your Benefits


Flexible and friendly work environment.
Hybrid work model.
Work-life balance.
Competitive salary.
Health insurance.
25 annual leave days.
Mobile phone and public transport allowances.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Pension Plan.


Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) [email protected] domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

The new hidden gem in Porto!

Your mission at ]init[ DCP

Do you want to actively shape the future of AI as a (Senior) AI Engineer (all genders)?

Are you eager to develop innovative solutions and create real value for the digital society? Then join ]init[ Portugal and become part of our team!

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to be based in Portugal.

What There Is To Do


Development, training, and optimization of AI and ML models with a focus on LLM and pipeline development
Implementation and integration of AI-driven solutions across a wide range of use cases
Working with modern frameworks and technologies to deliver intelligent automation
Development and maintenance of scalable backend services for AI models
Actively contributing to the AI strategy through innovative solution approaches


What You Bring Along


Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a comparable qualification
Several years of professional experience in developing AI/ML applications
Strong Python skills and experience with common AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
Experience in developing LLMs and NLP pipelines
Proficient in working with data processing tools such as Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib
Knowledge of prompting, vector embeddings, and fine-tuning of AI models
Excellent English and good German skills complete your profile


What We Offer


Stay flexible: Whether you prefer working remotely or in the office, the choice is yours. You can work from anywhere in Portugal, and even spend up to 30 days a year working from other EU countries.
Sustainability and work life balance: As a company committed to sustainability, we offer flexible working hours, part-time options, and unlimited contracts to help you balance work, life, and family.
Your well-being matters: We prioritize your health with meal allowances, comprehensive private health insurance, and 5 paid sick days.
Generous time off: With 25 vacation days plus public and local holidays, you’ll have plenty of time to recharge and bring your best to our tech-driven projects.
Ongoing development: We offer relevant training, conference participation, and role-specific certifications to support your growth.

Become part of our team

With us you make a real difference - also for your working life. Part-time or full-time, remote or in the office.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AI Engineer to join our team in Porto and help build the next generation of AI-native productivity inside Superhuman, specifically the agent platform where multiple AI agents collaborate to solve complex user problems. The ideal candidate is deeply excited about what's possible with LLMs today, has experience building with agents and AI workflows, and brings strong product sense alongside their engineering skills. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role on a foundational team that moves fast from idea to production.

We are evolving Superhuman Docs' collaborative workspaces so that users can solve arbitrarily complex tasks with agents, leveraging Superhuman’s ubiquitous UI.

As an AI Engineer on this team, you will be at the heart of our company's transformation.

In This Role, You Will


Shape the Future of Productivity: Play a pivotal role in evolving Grammarly from a beloved writing assistant into an indispensable, AI-native productivity suite for enterprises.
Build a Groundbreaking AI Agent Platform: Spearhead the development of a new platform where multiple AI agents collaborate to solve complex user problems. You will be responsible for the core orchestration, routing, and planning systems.
Own Critical ML Systems: Develop and deploy sophisticated ML models for core product experiences, including search ranking and proactive suggestions that anticipate user needs.
Integrate Cutting-Edge AI: Work at the forefront of the AI landscape, building ML components that integrate with the latest and most powerful models to create magical user experiences.
Thrive in a High-Impact Environment: Join a foundational team where you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and product sense in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Ship Your Work Fast: Move quickly from idea to impact. We have no red tape or endless approvals—just a focus on making meaningful contributions to a platform used by millions.


Qualifications


5+ years of industry experience as a machine learning engineer or applied research scientist.
A deep understanding of modern algorithms and approaches to ML, NLP, and LLMs.
Experience building LLM-based products.
A deep care about the end-user experience and strives to ensure high quality.
Ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manage tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyze and execute work efficiently, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrive in fast-paced, results-driven environments.
MS/PhD in Computer Science is a nice-to-have.


We invite you to share your knowledge, experience, and goals with us to help us find the best team match for you. Tell us your superpower!

Support for you, professionally and personally


Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being
A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.
Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Portugal: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.
Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.


We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

Compensation Range: €75K - €105K

Title: Analytics Engineer Mid
Description:
As a Mid-Level Analytics Engineer, you will support the development of Körber’s marketing analytics and reporting capabilities in a modern, AI-driven environment. Working closely with the data team, you will complete defined tasks in Databricks, contribute to AI agents that let users ask natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, and support selected reporting work in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric when needed. The role combines hands-on implementation with ad hoc analysis. You will need to understand relevant business logic so that your work is accurate, useful, and aligned with the intended reporting outcome. Our technology environment includes Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AI/ML services, and a central data lake.

Your role in our team



Implement SQL queries, data models, and reporting components in Databricks based on defined requirements.
Contribute to AI agents for natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, including prompt design, retrieval, testing, and evaluation.
Perform ad hoc analyses and data checks, applying relevant business logic and documenting assumptions and results.
Support the migration of selected reporting use cases from Power BI to Databricks and occasionally maintain or enhance reports in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Identify data quality issues, follow team standards for documentation and development, and collaborate with the data team to resolve open questions.



Your profile



Practical experience with SQL and Databricks or a similar cloud data platform.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, agent evaluation, or similar AI application patterns.
Genuine interest in AI, with the motivation to learn, experiment, and develop further in AI-assisted analytics.
Understanding of data analysis fundamentals and the ability to apply business logic to marketing, website, campaign, or CRM data.
Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including reports, datasets, or data models, to support occasional reporting tasks.
Reliable and collaborative working style, with the ability to complete assigned tasks, ask effective questions, and communicate clearly within the data team.



We offer you



Possibility of Working from Home – we care about results not locations;
Training Budget for each employee – we care about the growth of our people;
Private Health Insurance – we care about health on and off working hours;
3 Additional Vacation Days – we care about free time;
Fresh fruits – we care about your daily dose of vitamins;
Fresh coffee, tea or water – we care about boosting your day.
A home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do;
An environment where the team thinks and acts entrepreneurial;
An international and dynamic working atmosphere with cross-functional teams;
The opportunity to take more responsibility and develop your career.



Recruitment Team

For questions please contact us via Koerbercampusporto.recruitment@koerber.com Please apply exclusively via the “Apply now” button.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status.

This position is covered by the Collective Labour Agreement (Contrato Coletivo de Trabalho da FETESE).

Title: Analista de Dados (m/f) - SHEQ
Description:
Descrição da Oportunidade

Estamos a reforçar a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, responsável por apoiar a definição de diretrizes, standards, indicadores e práticas de gestão em Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade em todo o Grupo. Uma das nossas prioridades é evoluir para uma gestão SHEQ cada vez mais orientada por dados, capaz de antecipar riscos, identificar tendências e apoiar decisões mais informadas.

Procuramos um/a Analista de Dados para apoiar a definição, recolha, tratamento, automatização e análise de dados SHEQ, transformando informação operacional proveniente de diferentes fontes em dashboards, indicadores e insights acionáveis para diferentes níveis da organização.

Em articulação com a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, IT e equipas SHEQ e operacionais das várias unidades de negócio, contribuirá para transformar dados e tendências em informação útil para antecipar riscos, melhorar decisões e reforçar o desempenho SHEQ do Grupo

Requisitos da Função


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou área equivalente.
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em análise de dados, Business Intelligence, reporting corporativo, gestão e consolidação de informação ou funções similares.
Domínio de Power BI, DAX e Power Query, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios corporativos.
Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e bases de dados relacionais. Conhecimentos de Python ou de outras linguagens de análise e tratamento de dados serão valorizados.
Experiência na recolha, tratamento, validação, harmonização e consolidação de dados provenientes de múltiplos projetos, empresas ou unidades de negócio.
Conhecimentos de modelação de dados, definição de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e estruturação de modelos de informação para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Experiência na integração e automatização de fluxos de dados, incluindo processos ETL, APIs, Power Platform ou ferramentas equivalentes.
Conhecimentos de estatística aplicada e análise exploratória de dados, incluindo a identificação de tendências, correlações, desvios e fatores de risco. Experiência em analítica avançada ou modelos preditivos será valorizada.
Conhecimentos de governação, qualidade e gestão de dados, assegurando a sua integridade, consistência, rastreabilidade e comparabilidade entre diferentes fontes de informação.
Fluência em português (obrigatório) e inglês (mínimo B2). Conhecimentos de espanhol ou francês serão valorizados.
Conhecimento dos processos e indicadores de Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade (SHEQ), incluindo gestão de incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, observações, riscos, não conformidades e desempenho ambiental, será valorizado.
Conhecimento dos referenciais ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 será valorizado.
Disponibilidade para deslocações pontuais a projetos e mercados internacionais.


Principais tarefas


Definição, em articulação com as áreas SHEQ e operacionais, dos indicadores, dados e critérios de reporte necessários à monitorização do desempenho SHEQ.
Estruturação, harmonização e validação de dados provenientes de diferentes empresas, geografias e sistemas, assegurando a sua qualidade, consistência e comparabilidade.
Automatização dos processos de recolha, consolidação e tratamento de dados, promovendo a fiabilidade da informação.
Colaboração no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de plataformas, ferramentas de reporte e soluções digitais de suporte aos processos SHEQ.
Integração e análise de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, identificando tendências, desvios, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos corporativos, assegurando a qualidade e atualização da informação.
Produção de análises e insights sobre indicadores SHEQ, incluindo incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, não conformidades, ações corretivas e desempenho ambiental.
Implementação de mecanismos de monitorização da qualidade dos dados e promoção de boas práticas de governação da informação.
Apoio à identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria através da análise de tendências e do cruzamento de dados entre processos e unidades de negócio.
Exploração de soluções de análise avançada, inteligência artificial e modelos preditivos aplicados à melhoria do desempenho SHEQ.
Apoio à realização de auditorias internas e externas.


Perfil de competências


Pensamento analítico e rigor, com preocupação pela qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados.
Capacidade de comunicar através dos dados, traduzindo análises complexas em informação clara, útil e orientada à decisão.
Visão de negócio e sensibilidade SHEQ, compreendendo os processos operacionais e as necessidades de informação que suportam a tomada de decisão.
Autonomia e proatividade, com capacidade para propor soluções e promover a melhoria contínua.
Colaboração e relacionamento interpessoal, trabalhando em articulação com equipas SHEQ, IT, outras áreas corporativas e operacionais das diferentes unidades de negócio.
Curiosidade técnica e aprendizagem contínua, acompanhando a evolução das ferramentas de dados, automação e análise avançada.
Adaptabilidade e sensibilidade intercultural, essenciais num contexto internacional e multissetorial.
Orientação para o impacto, contribuindo para a melhoria do desempenho SHEQ e para a criação de valor para o Grupo.


O que oferecemos


Integração num Grupo multinacional de referência, com presença internacional e projetos em diferentes setores e geografias.
Oportunidade de desempenhar uma função com impacto direto na forma como a informação SHEQ é recolhida, analisada e utilizada para suportar a tomada de decisão.
Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital, contribuindo para a evolução dos sistemas de informação, indicadores e ferramentas de gestão SHEQ.
Trabalho com dados provenientes de diferentes projetos, empresas e geografias, proporcionando uma visão abrangente do negócio e dos seus desafios operacionais.
Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares das áreas SHEQ, Operações, Tecnologia e Gestão.
Possibilidade de aplicar e desenvolver competências em análise de dados, automação, Business Intelligence e análise avançada.
Ambiente de aprendizagem contínua, com contacto com diferentes realidades operacionais, culturas e práticas de gestão.

Uma das nossas prioridades é evoluir para uma gestão SHEQ cada vez mais orientada por dados, capaz de antecipar riscos, identificar tendências e apoiar decisões mais informadas.

Procuramos um/a Analista de Dados para apoiar a definição, recolha, tratamento, automatização e análise de dados SHEQ, transformando informação operacional proveniente de diferentes fontes em dashboards, indicadores e insights acionáveis para diferentes níveis da organização.

Em articulação com a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, IT e equipas SHEQ e operacionais das várias unidades de negócio, contribuirá para transformar dados e tendências em informação útil para antecipar riscos, melhorar decisões e reforçar o desempenho SHEQ do Grupo

Requisitos da Função

  • Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou área equivalente.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em análise de dados, Business Intelligence, reporting corporativo, gestão e consolidação de informação ou funções similares.
  • Domínio de Power BI, DAX e Power Query, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios corporativos.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e bases de dados relacionais. Conhecimentos de Python ou de outras linguagens de análise e tratamento de dados serão valorizados.
  • Experiência na recolha, tratamento, validação, harmonização e consolidação de dados provenientes de múltiplos projetos, empresas ou unidades de negócio.
  • Conhecimentos de modelação de dados, definição de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e estruturação de modelos de informação para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência na integração e automatização de fluxos de dados, incluindo processos ETL, APIs, Power Platform ou ferramentas equivalentes.
  • Conhecimentos de estatística aplicada e análise exploratória de dados, incluindo a identificação de tendências, correlações, desvios e fatores de risco. Experiência em analítica avançada ou modelos preditivos será valorizada.
  • Conhecimentos de governação, qualidade e gestão de dados, assegurando a sua integridade, consistência, rastreabilidade e comparabilidade entre diferentes fontes de informação.
  • Fluência em português (obrigatório) e inglês (mínimo B2). Conhecimentos de espanhol ou francês serão valorizados.
  • Conhecimento dos processos e indicadores de Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade (SHEQ), incluindo gestão de incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, observações, riscos, não conformidades e desempenho ambiental, será valorizado.
  • Conhecimento dos referenciais ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 será valorizado.
  • Disponibilidade para deslocações pontuais a projetos e mercados internacionais.

Principais tarefas

  • Definição, em articulação com as áreas SHEQ e operacionais, dos indicadores, dados e critérios de reporte necessários à monitorização do desempenho SHEQ.
  • Estruturação, harmonização e validação de dados provenientes de diferentes empresas, geografias e sistemas, assegurando a sua qualidade, consistência e comparabilidade.
  • Automatização dos processos de recolha, consolidação e tratamento de dados, promovendo a fiabilidade da informação.
  • Colaboração no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de plataformas, ferramentas de reporte e soluções digitais de suporte aos processos SHEQ.
  • Integração e análise de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, identificando tendências, desvios, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos corporativos, assegurando a qualidade e atualização da informação.
  • Produção de análises e insights sobre indicadores SHEQ, incluindo incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, não conformidades, ações corretivas e desempenho ambiental.
  • Implementação de mecanismos de monitorização da qualidade dos dados e promoção de boas práticas de governação da informação.
  • Apoio à identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria através da análise de tendências e do cruzamento de dados entre processos e unidades de negócio.
  • Exploração de soluções de análise avançada, inteligência artificial e modelos preditivos aplicados à melhoria do desempenho SHEQ.
  • Apoio à realização de auditorias internas e externas.

Perfil de competências

  • Pensamento analítico e rigor, com preocupação pela qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Capacidade de comunicar através dos dados, traduzindo análises complexas em informação clara, útil e orientada à decisão.
  • Visão de negócio e sensibilidade SHEQ, compreendendo os processos operacionais e as necessidades de informação que suportam a tomada de decisão.
  • Autonomia e proatividade, com capacidade para propor soluções e promover a melhoria contínua.
  • Colaboração e relacionamento interpessoal, trabalhando em articulação com equipas SHEQ, IT, outras áreas corporativas e operacionais das diferentes unidades de negócio.
  • Curiosidade técnica e aprendizagem contínua, acompanhando a evolução das ferramentas de dados, automação e análise avançada.
  • Adaptabilidade e sensibilidade intercultural, essenciais num contexto internacional e multissetorial.
  • Orientação para o impacto, contribuindo para a melhoria do desempenho SHEQ e para a criação de valor para o Grupo.

O que oferecemos

  • Integração num Grupo multinacional de referência, com presença internacional e projetos em diferentes setores e geografias.
  • Oportunidade de desempenhar uma função com impacto direto na forma como a informação SHEQ é recolhida, analisada e utilizada para suportar a tomada de decisão.
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital, contribuindo para a evolução dos sistemas de informação, indicadores e ferramentas de gestão SHEQ.
  • Trabalho com dados provenientes de diferentes projetos, empresas e geografias, proporcionando uma visão abrangente do negócio e dos seus desafios operacionais.
  • Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares das áreas SHEQ, Operações, Tecnologia e Gestão.
  • Possibilidade de aplicar e desenvolver competências em análise de dados, automação, Business Intelligence e análise avançada.
  • Ambiente de aprendizagem contínua, com contacto com diferentes realidades operacionais, culturas e práticas de gestão.

Title: AI Innovation Engineer MED
Description:
Professional | Full-Time

Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Digital Development Platform

About The Team

The AI Innovation Program sits within Digital Development Platform and is responsible for accelerating AI adoption through practical, business-focused innovation. We partner closely with frontline teams and business stakeholders to rapidly design, build, and validate AI-enabled solutions that improve operational performance and simplify everyday work.

As an AI Innovation Engineer, you will combine technical problem-solving with business understanding to develop practical solutions that address real operational challenges. Working directly with users and AI Innovation Leads, you will help transform ideas into working solutions and generate measurable business value through AI, automation, analytics, and integrations.

Professionals who enjoy developing ideas, exploring possibilities, and working with stakeholders to deliver effective solutions will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities

As an AI Innovation Engineer, you will contribute to the impact of AI transformation initiatives by:


Collaborating with frontline operators, subject matter experts, and business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and identify solution opportunities
Designing, building, and testing AI-enabled, automation, and data-driven solutions using approved development tools and platforms
Translating business requirements and target workflows into practical technical designs and scalable solution architectures
Assessing technical feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, and solution risks to support informed decision-making
Integrating business systems, data sources, and automation capabilities to create reliable and efficient workflows
Supporting user testing, gathering structured feedback, and continuously improving solutions based on operational performance
Documenting technical assets, reusable components, integrations, testing outcomes, and implementation learnings to support future scalability
Communicating technical concepts, trade-offs, and implementation considerations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
Approximately 2-5 years of experience developing software, automation, analytics, data, or AI-enabled solutions
Practical experience with APIs, integrations, data preparation, workflow automation, and modern development tools
Practical experience with AI, automation, and data technologies, including their practical business applications and implementation considerations
Experience collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders in cross-functional environments
Familiarity with solution design, testing methodologies, and continuous improvement practices
Advanced problem-solving skills and a structured approach to delivering results
Fluent written and spoken communication skills in English


Competencies


Applies a user-centric mindset to design practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
Demonstrates deep technical curiosity and continuously explores emerging AI, automation, and digital technologies
Applies a structured problem-solving approach to address complex technical and operational challenges
Effectively translates business needs into technical solutions and technical concepts into business language
Collaborates effectively across disciplines, functions, and stakeholder groups
Balances speed, quality, scalability, and business value when developing solutions
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and persistence when overcoming implementation challenges
Balances shifting priorities and performs strongly in environments that encourage innovation


What We Offer

Purpose. An opportunity to contribute to climate action and support future generations through AI-driven transformation and innovation.

A visible role that helps shape how AI delivers value across Vestas by working directly with business leaders, frontline teams, and Digital Solutions. A highly visible role working directly with business leaders, frontline teams, and Digital Solutions to shape how AI creates value across Vestas.

Growth. Opportunities to work on complex business challenges, engage with executive stakeholders, and support large-scale transformation efforts while deepening knowledge of AI-enabled business innovation.

Collaboration. A trusted, diverse, and highly collaborative environment where learning, experimentation, and knowledge sharing are encouraged.

Versatility. A healthy work-life balance with flexible working options and opportunities to work across multiple business domains.

We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. Title: Data Delivery Consultant | Technology Risk (Assurance)
HTML:
The opportunity

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you.

We are looking for a Data Delivery Consultant to join our Technology Risk team within Assurance.

In this role, you will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, supporting the delivery of data-driven solutions and analyses that contribute to technology risk and assurance engagements. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who is interested in combining data, technology and business in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Data Delivery Consultant, you will:

  • Support the collection, extraction, transformation and analysis of data from different sources;
  • Assist in preparing and validating datasets used in Technology Risk and Assurance engagements;
  • Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and analytical procedures to help identify inconsistencies and relevant trends;
  • Support the development of data analytics, reports and visualizations to provide meaningful insights to engagement teams;
  • Collaborate with Technology Risk professionals and other Assurance teams to understand business requirements and translate them into data needs;
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement and automation of data-related processes;
  • Prepare clear documentation of analyses, methodologies and outputs;
  • Build knowledge of EY methodologies, technology risk concepts and emerging data and technology trends.

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for professionals who have:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
  • Interest in data analytics, technology and digital environments;
  • Ability to work with large and complex datasets with attention to detail;
  • Good communication and teamwork skills;
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to learn;
  • Ability to organize priorities and work effectively in a collaborative environment.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Management, Economics or another relevant field;
  • Up to 2 years of professional experience, ideally involving data analysis, technology, reporting or related areas;
  • Knowledge of Excel and familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools;
  • Basic knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Python, Alteryx or similar technologies is valued;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and a good level of English.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Previous exposure to data analytics or data transformation projects;
  • Interest in Technology Risk, IT environments, internal controls or Assurance;
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and how data can support better business decisions;
  • Experience in multidisciplinary or project-based environments.

What We Look For

We are looking for curious and motivated people who enjoy working with data and technology and are eager to develop their skills in a fast-changing environment. If you have an analytical mindset, attention to detail and want to understand how technology and data support organizations and their decision-making processes, this could be the opportunity for you.

What We Offer

At EY, you’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. You’ll work with multidisciplinary teams, gain exposure to different industries and business challenges, and have access to learning opportunities that will support your professional development.

EY | Shape the future with confidence

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, we're committed to providing recruitment and career opportunities to all, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, social background or disability. We believe that equality and diversity are central to our recruitment process, as they enhance creativity and efficiency, leading to improved performance and productivity. In line with this commitment, EY Portugal recently became a member of the Inclusive Community Forum. This initiative, led by Nova SBE, focuses on the recruitment of individuals with disabilities, advocating for a more inclusive community. Moreover, EY Portugal has also endorsed the Diversity Charter of APPDI (the Portuguese Association for Diversity and Inclusion), pledging to establish and develop internal policies and practices which support diversity. Through these initiatives, EY seeks to actively contribute to the inclusion process, and promote a more inclusive community for people with disabilities, by actively participating in creating solutions.

Title: Consumer Insights & Analytics Internship
Description:
About BrandDelta

At BrandDelta, we help some of the world's leading Consumer Goods and Direct-to-Consumer brands make better commercial and marketing decisions through data.

By combining consumer, market and commercial data with advanced analytics and AI, we transform complex information into clear insights that help businesses grow.

As an intern, you'll join BrandDelta for a paid, 12-month internship, becoming part of an international team working on real client projects from day one. You'll collaborate with experienced consultants, analysts and data scientists while developing practical analytical and business skills that will support your future career.




What you'll learn

During your paid 12-month internship, you'll gain exposure to how data supports business decision-making across Marketing, Consumer Insights and Revenue Growth Management, working with clients across Japan, Europe and the US.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Analyse consumer, brand and market trends.
Explore pricing, promotions and commercial performance.
Work with a variety of real-world datasets.
Develop analytical and problem-solving skills.
Build compelling presentations and business recommendations.
Learn how global Consumer Goods companies use data to make informed choices.




What you'll be doing

As part of the BrandDelta team, you'll contribute to real client projects while learning how data can be transformed into meaningful business insights and commercial recommendations. Throughout your internship, you'll have the opportunity to:

Research consumer behaviour, market trends and brand performance using a variety of data sources, including social media, search, reviews, surveys, sales and market data.
Analyse datasets to identify patterns, trends and opportunities that help answer real business and commercial questions.
Support projects related to consumer insights, pricing, promotions, sales performance, product portfolios and Revenue Growth Management.
Transform data into clear insights and compelling business recommendations through reports, dashboards and presentations.
Develop your analytical, problem-solving and storytelling skills by communicating findings in a clear, engaging and business-focused way.
Collaborate with colleagues across our Data & AI, Modelling and Insights teams, gaining exposure to different disciplines and learning how multidisciplinary teams solve complex business challenges for leading global Consumer Goods and D2C brands.




Who we're looking for

We're looking for students and recent graduates who are naturally curious, enjoy solving problems and are excited by the idea of using data to answer real business questions.

You'll be a great fit if you:

Are currently completing or have recently completed a degree in Business, Economics, Management, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field.
Have a strong record of academic achievement and extracurricular involvement.
Enjoy analysing information and turning it into meaningful insights.
Have an interest in consumer behaviour, brands, markets and business strategy.
Are comfortable working with numbers and keen to develop your analytical skills.
Communicate ideas clearly and enjoy working collaboratively with others.
Take initiative, are eager to learn and enjoy challenging yourself.
Are fluent in English, as you'll be working in an international environment.




Nice to have

You don't need previous professional experience to apply. However, it would be great if you've had exposure to any of the following through your studies, personal projects or previous internships:

Microsoft Excel and data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Basic knowledge of Python, R, SQL or other analytical tools.
Data analysis, consumer research or business analytics projects.
Marketing, commercial strategy, finance or market research concepts.
An interest in the Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry and how brands use data to make commercial and marketing decisions.




What you'll gain

At BrandDelta, we believe an internship should be more than just a learning experience — it should be the start of your professional journey.

Throughout your internship, you'll have the opportunity to:

Contribute to real projects for leading international Consumer Goods and D2C brands.
Learn from experienced consultants, analysts and data specialists through ongoing mentoring and collaboration.
Develop practical skills in data analysis, business problem-solving and strategic thinking.
Gain hands-on experience with modern analytics, AI and data visualisation tools.
Understand how global organisations use consumer, market and commercial insights to drive business growth.
Strengthen your communication and presentation skills by transforming data into clear business recommendations.
Build a solid foundation for a career in Analytics, Consumer Insights, Revenue Growth Management, Consulting, Marketing or Commercial Strategy.

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose


As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.


Responsibilities


Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.


Education


Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.


Experience


Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.


Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role Overview

This is a long-term fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to turn customer and revenue data into models and insights that directly move the top line — reducing churn, surfacing cross-sell opportunities, and giving the business a clear view of what's driving revenue.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, owns problems end-to-end, and can balance rigorous modelling with pragmatic delivery.

What You Will Do


Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.
Cross-sell & upsell — Develop propensity models and next-best-action recommendations to help commercial teams prioritise accounts and product conversations.
Revenue attribution & tracking — Design attribution frameworks across marketing channels, sales motions, and product touchpoints. Build the data products that let leadership see what's actually driving revenue.
Experimentation — Design and analyse A/B tests and quasi-experiments for commercial initiatives. Bring statistical rigour to business decisions.
Productionisation — Take models from notebook to production. Own the full lifecycle: feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
Stakeholder partnership — Translate ambiguous commercial questions into well-scoped analytical problems. Communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.


Who You Are


5+ years in applied data science, with significant experience on commercial problems (churn, LTV, propensity, attribution, pricing, or similar).
Strong SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Comfortable building production-grade code, not just notebooks.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse — BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Experience deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, or similar).
Solid grounding in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference — you know when a correlation isn't enough.
Track record of shipping models that are actually used by the business, not just built.
Excellent communication — you can explain a model to a CFO and debug a feature pipeline with an engineer in the same afternoon.


Nice-to-have


Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
Exposure to payments, fintech, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue businesses.
DBT experience for analytics engineering.
Experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into commercial workflows.


Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Bring your unique talents and experience to a leading company in Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions. Grow your passion into a rewarding profession by joining a dynamic and expanding organization. You’ll play a vital role that supports your success and helps drive safe, efficient, and reliable operations across industries worldwide.

Where you’ll work: This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our engineers consistently tell us they value.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

You will own machine learning solutions end to end — from framing the business problem to running models reliably in production — built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors deployed around the world.

Collaborate for success


Own machine learning projects end to end: plan the roadmap, frame the problem, build the pipelines, and take solutions through to production.
Translate business goals into ML solutions, and explain results, limitations and uncertainty to business stakeholders in terms they can act on.
Make the technical decisions, contribute significantly to the implementation, and mentor other engineers through code review and design discussion. This is a hands-on role.


Build ML-powered solutions


Deliver forecasting, classification and anomaly detection on time series from industrial IoT sensors reporting in real time from sites across the globe.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, scarce labels, and a device population that keeps evolving.
Run what you build — monitoring, drift detection and retraining — and shape the data pipelines your models depend on.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on model risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any model whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across data engineering, machine learning and MLOps, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

Minimum Requirements -


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field or equivalent combination of education and experience
5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or a closely related software engineering role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred).
Hands-on experience delivering production-level, cloud-native machine learning solutions.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong understanding of feature engineering, ML algorithms, model training and evaluation.
Solid experience across a modern ML stack: gradient boosting (LightGBM, XGBoost), scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow, and current time series tooling.
Experience operating models in production: deployment, monitoring, drift detection and retraining, and a feel for the MLOps practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.


Preferred Qualifications -


Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, MLflow, streaming pipelines.
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar patterns for exposing models as tools other agents can call directly.
Domain experience in industrial, energy or IoT settings.

Title: AI Builder
Description:
In 1966, in Marseille, Pierre Bellon laid the foundations of what would become Sodexo, guided by a simple yet powerful idea: improving everyday life through services that truly matter.

Today, Sodexo is a global leader in Food and Services, supporting people at every moment of life, at work, in schools, hospitals and communities. With 426,000 colleagues across 43 countries, we serve 80 million consumers every day, generating €24.1 billion in revenues. Our growth goes hand in hand with social and environmental responsibility, driven by our purpose: to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all.




About Sodexo Business Services (SBS)




Portugal is no exception! Eight years ago, we established Sodexo Business Services (SBS), our shared service center. Here, you will have the opportunity to join various Financial teams such as Record to Report, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Financial Analysis, and Master Data, supporting European markets and ensuring business growth.




Join Us!

We are looking for talented professionals to be part of our team, bringing unique skills and perspectives to help us grow even further.




AI Builder




⚙What will you do?




AI Use Case Discovery & Delivery:

Identify and prioritise high-value AI and automation opportunities across GSM, BI and regional teams.
Translate business challenges, process inefficiencies and user needs into practical, testable use cases with clear value, feasibility and risk assessments.
Build and validate prototypes/MVPs in short cycles, leveraging AI, automation, data and low-code technologies to rapidly demonstrate impact.
Select fit-for-purpose solutions that balance speed, scalability, simplicity, cost and governance requirements.




User Adoption & Value Realisation:

Engage users early to test solutions, gather feedback and continuously improve usefulness, usability and trust.
Measure success through business outcomes such as efficiency gains, quality improvements, adoption and user experience.
Recommend whether solutions should be scaled, enhanced, reused or discontinued based on demonstrated value and business needs.




Capability Building & Responsible Scale-Up:

Work closely with IS&T, AI specialists and business stakeholders to industrialise successful solutions and ensure compliance with security, governance and data standards.
Promote responsible AI adoption by sharing best practices, reusable assets and lessons learned across teams and regions.
Strengthen AI and automation capabilities within GSM and BI through coaching, knowledge sharing and practical demonstrations.







🤙 What you'll need to succeed?

A hands-on builder who is comfortable working across business, analytics and technology, and can take an idea from a loosely defined problem through to a working solution.
3 to 5 years' relevant experience across analytics, data, automation, digital products or applied AI, with a strong track record of building and improving practical solutions.
Strong commercial and business judgement, with the ability to understand what matters to stakeholders, recognise where value can be created, and focus technical effort on solutions that are practical, useful and worth the investment.
Practical experience using Generative AI and LLM-based tools to solve real business problems, with a good understanding of their capabilities, limitations and appropriate use.
Strong data and analytical foundations, including experience working with messy or complex data, data quality issues, data models and multiple information sources.
Working capability in Python and SQL, or equivalent technologies, sufficient to manipulate data, automate tasks and build prototypes independently.
Ability to combine AI, data, automation, APIs and low-code/no-code tools to create working solutions, selecting the simplest effective approach for the problem.
Strong problem-framing and analytical skills, with the ability to uncover the real need behind an initial request, turn ambiguity into something testable, and assess value, feasibility, risk and potential to scale.
Strong user focus, with the ability to test solutions in practice, respond to feedback and improve usability, accuracy and adoption.
Sound judgement around testing, data handling, security, governance and responsible AI, including the confidence to challenge unreliable outputs or conclude that AI is not the right solution.
Able to work with a high level of autonomy, move quickly through experimentation and adapt as both the technology and the role evolve.
Strong communicator and facilitator who can explain AI in straightforward business language, engage sceptical or time-poor stakeholders, and share knowledge across business and technical teams.
Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure or similar enterprise data and AI platforms is highly valued but not eliminatory.
Fluency in English is required and adittional languages are a plus.

Hybrid working model;
Flexible working hours;
Health & Life Insurance;
