Title: Lead Data Consultant
Description:
Company Description

Hitachi Solutions Europe is a global Digital, Data and Technology consultancy, Microsoft Solution Partner and Cloud Services partner, specialising in end-to-end transformation.

As a global consultancy company working across the private and public sectors, we specialise in Dynamics 365 Business Applications, Power Platform, including Azure, Application Modernisation and Data & Analytics.

Our highly skilled team help drive improvements, creating efficiency and growth within organisations. We are committed to Microsoft technologies, with a mission to revolutionise modern businesses.

To achieve this we employ the best, most dedicated talent to deliver outstanding technology solutions to both our local and global clients.

Be part of our Hitachi family

We place value on collaboration, open communication, and transparency. We emphasise the importance of team spirit, cohesion, and appreciation. Through our talented people, innovative culture, and technical and business expertise, we deliver game changing outcomes every day. Our learning culture and flat hierarchy are our recipes for success.

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead Data Consultant to join us on our exciting journey and be part of our Hitachi Solutions family.

This is a unique and challenging opportunity for an experienced Analytics Consultant to join the Data, Analytics & AI practice of Hitachi Solutions Portugal.

In this role you will be providing bespoke and cutting-edge data and advanced analytics solutions, bringing significant commercial advantage to some of Europe’s most recognised companies.

The successful candidate will draw upon their experience with data engineering and business intelligence tools and techniques to advise clients on data and analytics best practices and deliver data and analytics solutions on time and to budget.

The Main Areas Of Responsibility Are


Provide expert advisory services to clients on advanced analytics and data engineering best practices, ensuring delivery of scalable and efficient solutions.
Lead teams and projects, supporting all aspects of delivery from requirements gathering to solution design and implementation.
Capture client requirements and lead the development of solution architectures that meet both current and future business needs.
Design and develop bespoke Data Platform, Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions, leveraging the latest cloud technologies.
Lead the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise data engineering solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks, delivering robust, secure, and scalable data products that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
Build and oversee the development of dynamic, interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, ensuring clear, actionable insights for clients.
Guide teams in data modelling and transformation efforts, ensuring the development of optimised data architectures, including the design of ETL/ELT pipelines.
Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their professional development.
Actively contribute to the development of the team in Portugal, ensuring close ties to the rest of the European team.


Qualifications

We are looking to hire ambitious consulting professionals who combine their technical acumen with a genuine enthusiasm for improving organisations:


10+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-based Data Engineering, Analytics, and AI solutions, ideally within a consulting or systems integration environment.
Extensive experience in a client-facing role, previously working for a consultancy or systems integrator, with a proven track record of leading teams or projects.
Hands-on experience with modern programming languages such as Python and SQL.
Familiarity with data integration tools like Azure Data Factory and Data platform solutions such as Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.
Expertise in data visualisation and analytics using Power BI, QlikView or Tableau.
Strong experience in data modelling and transformation, including the design of ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing solutions
Experience or awareness of Big Data and Data Science and/or AI technologies, including the integration of Machine Learning models and/or Generative AI components.
Experience in leading, mentoring, and developing Data & Analytics teams, with a passion for coaching and growing talent.
Demonstrated leadership within the Data Engineering and AI domain, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and client management skills.


Additional Information

Your Benefits


Flexible and friendly work environment.
Hybrid work model.
Work-life balance.
Competitive salary.
Health insurance.
25 annual leave days.
Mobile phone and public transport allowances.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Pension Plan.


Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) [email protected] domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

Title: AI Innovation Engineer MED
Description:
Professional | Full-Time

Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Digital Development Platform

About The Team

The AI Innovation Program sits within Digital Development Platform and is responsible for accelerating AI adoption through practical, business-focused innovation. We partner closely with frontline teams and business stakeholders to rapidly design, build, and validate AI-enabled solutions that improve operational performance and simplify everyday work.

As an AI Innovation Engineer, you will combine technical problem-solving with business understanding to develop practical solutions that address real operational challenges. Working directly with users and AI Innovation Leads, you will help transform ideas into working solutions and generate measurable business value through AI, automation, analytics, and integrations.

Professionals who enjoy developing ideas, exploring possibilities, and working with stakeholders to deliver effective solutions will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities

As an AI Innovation Engineer, you will contribute to the impact of AI transformation initiatives by:


Collaborating with frontline operators, subject matter experts, and business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and identify solution opportunities
Designing, building, and testing AI-enabled, automation, and data-driven solutions using approved development tools and platforms
Translating business requirements and target workflows into practical technical designs and scalable solution architectures
Assessing technical feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, and solution risks to support informed decision-making
Integrating business systems, data sources, and automation capabilities to create reliable and efficient workflows
Supporting user testing, gathering structured feedback, and continuously improving solutions based on operational performance
Documenting technical assets, reusable components, integrations, testing outcomes, and implementation learnings to support future scalability
Communicating technical concepts, trade-offs, and implementation considerations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
Approximately 2-5 years of experience developing software, automation, analytics, data, or AI-enabled solutions
Practical experience with APIs, integrations, data preparation, workflow automation, and modern development tools
Practical experience with AI, automation, and data technologies, including their practical business applications and implementation considerations
Experience collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders in cross-functional environments
Familiarity with solution design, testing methodologies, and continuous improvement practices
Advanced problem-solving skills and a structured approach to delivering results
Fluent written and spoken communication skills in English


Competencies


Applies a user-centric mindset to design practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
Demonstrates deep technical curiosity and continuously explores emerging AI, automation, and digital technologies
Applies a structured problem-solving approach to address complex technical and operational challenges
Effectively translates business needs into technical solutions and technical concepts into business language
Collaborates effectively across disciplines, functions, and stakeholder groups
Balances speed, quality, scalability, and business value when developing solutions
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and persistence when overcoming implementation challenges
Balances shifting priorities and performs strongly in environments that encourage innovation


What We Offer

Purpose. An opportunity to contribute to climate action and support future generations through AI-driven transformation and innovation.

A visible role that helps shape how AI delivers value across Vestas by working directly with business leaders, frontline teams, and Digital Solutions. A highly visible role working directly with business leaders, frontline teams, and Digital Solutions to shape how AI creates value across Vestas.

Growth. Opportunities to work on complex business challenges, engage with executive stakeholders, and support large-scale transformation efforts while deepening knowledge of AI-enabled business innovation.

Collaboration. A trusted, diverse, and highly collaborative environment where learning, experimentation, and knowledge sharing are encouraged.

Versatility. A healthy work-life balance with flexible working options and opportunities to work across multiple business domains.

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. Title: Consumer Insights & Analytics Internship
Description:
About BrandDelta

At BrandDelta, we help some of the world's leading Consumer Goods and Direct-to-Consumer brands make better commercial and marketing decisions through data.

By combining consumer, market and commercial data with advanced analytics and AI, we transform complex information into clear insights that help businesses grow.

As an intern, you'll join BrandDelta for a paid, 12-month internship, becoming part of an international team working on real client projects from day one. You'll collaborate with experienced consultants, analysts and data scientists while developing practical analytical and business skills that will support your future career.




What you'll learn

During your paid 12-month internship, you'll gain exposure to how data supports business decision-making across Marketing, Consumer Insights and Revenue Growth Management, working with clients across Japan, Europe and the US.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Analyse consumer, brand and market trends.
Explore pricing, promotions and commercial performance.
Work with a variety of real-world datasets.
Develop analytical and problem-solving skills.
Build compelling presentations and business recommendations.
Learn how global Consumer Goods companies use data to make informed choices.




What you'll be doing

As part of the BrandDelta team, you'll contribute to real client projects while learning how data can be transformed into meaningful business insights and commercial recommendations. Throughout your internship, you'll have the opportunity to:

Research consumer behaviour, market trends and brand performance using a variety of data sources, including social media, search, reviews, surveys, sales and market data.
Analyse datasets to identify patterns, trends and opportunities that help answer real business and commercial questions.
Support projects related to consumer insights, pricing, promotions, sales performance, product portfolios and Revenue Growth Management.
Transform data into clear insights and compelling business recommendations through reports, dashboards and presentations.
Develop your analytical, problem-solving and storytelling skills by communicating findings in a clear, engaging and business-focused way.
Collaborate with colleagues across our Data & AI, Modelling and Insights teams, gaining exposure to different disciplines and learning how multidisciplinary teams solve complex business challenges for leading global Consumer Goods and D2C brands.




Who we're looking for

We're looking for students and recent graduates who are naturally curious, enjoy solving problems and are excited by the idea of using data to answer real business questions.

You'll be a great fit if you:

Are currently completing or have recently completed a degree in Business, Economics, Management, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field.
Have a strong record of academic achievement and extracurricular involvement.
Enjoy analysing information and turning it into meaningful insights.
Have an interest in consumer behaviour, brands, markets and business strategy.
Are comfortable working with numbers and keen to develop your analytical skills.
Communicate ideas clearly and enjoy working collaboratively with others.
Take initiative, are eager to learn and enjoy challenging yourself.
Are fluent in English, as you'll be working in an international environment.




Nice to have

You don't need previous professional experience to apply. However, it would be great if you've had exposure to any of the following through your studies, personal projects or previous internships:

Microsoft Excel and data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Basic knowledge of Python, R, SQL or other analytical tools.
Data analysis, consumer research or business analytics projects.
Marketing, commercial strategy, finance or market research concepts.
An interest in the Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry and how brands use data to make commercial and marketing decisions.




What you'll gain

At BrandDelta, we believe an internship should be more than just a learning experience — it should be the start of your professional journey.

Throughout your internship, you'll have the opportunity to:

Contribute to real projects for leading international Consumer Goods and D2C brands.
Learn from experienced consultants, analysts and data specialists through ongoing mentoring and collaboration.
Develop practical skills in data analysis, business problem-solving and strategic thinking.
Gain hands-on experience with modern analytics, AI and data visualisation tools.
Understand how global organisations use consumer, market and commercial insights to drive business growth.
Strengthen your communication and presentation skills by transforming data into clear business recommendations.
Build a solid foundation for a career in Analytics, Consumer Insights, Revenue Growth Management, Consulting, Marketing or Commercial Strategy.

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose


As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.


Responsibilities


Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.


Education


Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.


Experience


Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.


Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

Title: Business Analyst & Advisor
HTML:
Somos uma empresa de todos e para todos. Na MC, colocamos as pessoas no centro: clientes, colaboradores e comunidade. Criamos valor juntos, inovamos a cada passo e lideramos de forma próxima, reconhecendo as qualidades de cada um. Diferentes histórias e ideias unem-nos no mesmo propósito: crescer e chegar à melhor versão de nós próprios. Porque tudo o que somos, conseguimos juntos.


Temos experiências, perspetivas e percursos diferentes, mas partilhamos a mesma ambição: construir melhores soluções para os nossos clientes e alcançar, juntos, a nossa melhor versão.


Por isso, junta-te a nós!


Estamos à procura de Business Analyst & Advisor para a nossa equipa de Assortment Analytics (CoE), em Matosinhos, e acreditamos que seremos #betterwithyou!


Integrarás o Centro de Excelência de Assortment, uma equipa que trabalha em estreita colaboração com as áreas Comerciais e de Operações para garantir a definição e otimização das gamas de produtos nas nossas lojas. Terás um papel ativo na geração de insights, na análise de dados e na recomendação de soluções que contribuam para decisões estratégicas centradas no cliente e no crescimento sustentável do negócio.


Contamos contigo para…

  • Contribuir para a definição e otimização das estratégias de gama e espaço das diferentes categorias e formatos de loja;
  • Transformar dados em insights que suportem decisões estratégicas e promovam o crescimento do negócio;
  • Identificar tendências de mercado, oportunidades de melhoria e novos padrões de consumo através da análise de dados e da monitorização do mercado;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar indicadores-chave de performance, como vendas, margem, rentabilidade, quota de mercado e produtividade;
  • Desenvolver análises quantitativas e recomendações de negócio para apoiar projetos estratégicos e decisões comerciais;
  • Assumir a gestão de projetos e iniciativas transversais, desde o diagnóstico inicial até à implementação e avaliação de impacto;
  • Atuar como parceiro consultivo das equipas de negócio, comunicando conclusões e recomendações de forma clara e orientada para a ação;
  • Promover melhorias contínuas em processos, metodologias e ferramentas analíticas.


Por isso, traz contigo…

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Gestão, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas similares;
  • Experiência profissional mínima de 3 anos em funções de Business Analytics, Consultoria, Estratégia, Category Management ou áreas relevantes de Retalho e FMCG;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e experiência na interpretação de dados para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Domínio de Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Conhecimentos de SQL e Python serão valorizados;
  • Bons conhecimentos de Inglês;
  • Experiência na gestão de projetos e interação com múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e influência, adaptando a mensagem a diferentes públicos;
  • Elevado sentido de organização e gestão de prioridades;
  • Pensamento crítico, curiosidade intelectual e orientação para a resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e foco na geração de impacto.


O que temos para ti…

  • Subsídio de Alimentação em Cartão Dá;
  • Plano de Telecomunicações com voz, dados e equipamento;
  • Programa Flex it Up;
  • Seguro de Saúde e de Vida;

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY




We are looking for a Python Developer to join an innovation team within the IT risk area of the banking sector, supporting the development and optimization of quantitative risk solutions, including stress testing and rating engine capabilities.




WHAT YOU WILL DO




- Develop, maintain and improve Python-based components supporting quantitative risk and finance-related applications.

- Work with data queries, data manipulation and technical analysis to support rating engine and stress testing processes.

- Collaborate with technical and risk teams to understand requirements and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions.

- Use version control and development practices to support code quality, traceability and continuous improvement.

- Progressively contribute to automation, pipeline integration and development best practices within the team.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR




- University student or graduate in Computer Science, Mathematics or another quantitative field.

- More than 3 years of professional, academic or project-based experience with software development or data-oriented technical work.

- Strong motivation to work in a quantitative risk, finance or banking technology environment.

- Responsible, collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, with willingness to learn and improve continuously.

- Ability to work in a hybrid model in Porto.




TECHNICAL SKILLS




- Python 3

- SQL

- Linux command line

- Git

- Data manipulation

- Software development best practices

- CI/CD concepts




NICE TO HAVE




- Jenkins

- Bitbucket

- SonarQube

- Experience or academic exposure to quantitative finance, risk models or rating engines




WHAT WE OFFER




- Private health insurance from day one, with optional family extension.

- Confidential mental health support, including psychological support, content and live sessions.

- Continuous learning and development through training and certification support.

- Flexibility whenever the role and project context allow it.

- Team moments, shared milestones and close leadership presence.

- Upskilling opportunities in quality management, information security, AI governance and cybersecurity best practices.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY




Hexa is committed to inclusive and responsible recruitment practices, aligned with the principles of the Portuguese Diversity Charter. We welcome people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.




HEXA LIFE




At Hexa, every professional is a Builder. We work with honesty, mutual support and agility, creating strong relationships, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that generate long-term impact.

Title: AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst [F/M/X]
Description:
Job Description

As part of Mantu’s continued growth and digital transformation, we are looking for an AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst to join our IT team.

Reporting to the Data & AI Manager, you will help establish and operate Mantu’s AI FinOps capability. Your role will sit at the intersection of IT operations, data analytics, AI platform management, and financial governance.

You will provide visibility into AI and LLM consumption, build the data foundations and dashboards required to monitor usage and costs, and help the organisation optimise the performance, scalability, and commercial value of its AI platforms.

You will work closely with the Data & AI, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, and business teams to ensure that AI services are used efficiently, sustainably, and in line with Mantu’s technical and commercial objectives.

Your missions



Build dashboard-level visibility into AI platform spend (e.g., Dust, Claude), identifying which agents and use cases drive costs
Develop predictive consumption models that go beyond linear extrapolation, enabling accurate forecasting of AI/LLM costs
Report monthly on cost, consumption trends, and risk exposure to relevant stakeholders
Identify and shift workloads off premium models where not justified, optimizing spend by aligning tasks with appropriate model tiers
Track model pricing evolution and reassess cost/quality tradeoffs as new models are released
Monitor consumption against contracted thresholds and flag commercial risks proactively
Support contract negotiation and renewal discussions with AI platform vendors in collaboration with Procurement and the AI team
Build and continuously refine Mantu’s AI cost model, incorporating external advisory input and documenting methodology for future client-facing offers[doc1]



Your profile

You have a strong interest in the intersection of IT, data, artificial intelligence, cloud platforms, and cost optimisation. You are comfortable working with technical teams and translating complex usage data into clear recommendations for business and financial stakeholders.



Experience in IT, data analytics, cloud operations, platform engineering, FinOps, or AI operations.
Experience with modeling, Python or SQL for data extraction, and generative AI tools
Academic background: Master’s degree in management, engineering, or a related field
English fluent. French is a plus.
Experience with cloud or SaaS FinOps practices
Experience building and maintaining cost dashboards or models
Familiarity with AI/LLM commercial models, including token or credit-based pricing, tiered contracts, and overage rates
You demonstrate the ability to build and defend cost/value models to non-technical stakeholders
You demonstrate comfort working with high-variance, unpredictable cost data and understanding of budget and vendor contracts
You demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to translate technical usage into actionable cost insights



Remuneration

Gross Annual Salary (GAS): EUR 22,000 - EUR 40,000 (basic salary only, the variable component will be detailed in the offer)

What We Offer



An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities
An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)
At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.



Mantu is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics

Who are we?

Mantu is an independent international consulting player, founded in 2007. Bringing together expert and complementary brands, Mantu stands out for the breadth of its spectrum, responding to all business transformation challenges.

Its activities are divided into four practices:

Leadership & Advocacy, Technology, Brand Strategy & Experiences and Total Talent Management.

A wide range of skills, all serving a single mission: connecting and powering companies with leading teams and technology to succeed faster and sustainably. 

From its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, Mantu relies on a community of 12,000 talented people in more than 60 countries on 5 continents and has a turnover of 1billion euros.

Title: Data Engineer & Analyst
Description:
Snapshot of your day

At Siemens Energy, we are building the next-generation HR Data Platform - a global foundation for data consolidation, governance, and analytics. We are looking for a hybrid Data Engineer & Analyst who can bridge the gap between raw data infrastructure and business intelligence.

In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle: from maintaining the consolidation layer and pipelines of our HR Data Hub to designing the final reporting solutions that empower strategic workforce decisions. You will ensure our data is not only technically sound but also accessible and insightful for business stakeholders.

How You’ll Make a Difference


Data Pipeline & Transformation Management: Design and maintain the transformation layer (using dbt and SQL) for the Internal Platform, ensuring raw data is effectively consolidated and modeled for downstream use
Analytics & Dashboarding: Develop and optimize dashboards (PowerBI) to provide key insights for HR and Operations units, directly supporting strategic business decisions
Data Quality & Governance: Act as a guardian for data integrity by implementing governance practices and monitoring data quality patterns to find and fix common issues in structured and unstructured data
Legacy Migration & Optimization: Lead or support migration projects to move legacy data pipelines to modern cloud infrastructure, aiming to eliminate technical debt, reduce costs, and restore stakeholder trust
Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data processing and reporting tasks (using Python or SQL procedures), reducing manual handling time for the HR team
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Establish clear documentation for data models and processes, creating a central knowledge base to ensure continuity and team alignment



What You Bring


Hybrid Experience: Proven cross-industry experience acting as both a Data Engineer and Data Analyst, with the ability to navigate complex pipelines and deliver business-facing insights
Core Engineering Stack: Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation, along with experience in modern Data Warehousing (Snowflake)
Transformation & Visualization: Proficiency with dbt for data transformation and major visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to troubleshooting, with experience in navigating complex or legacy data environments and driving infrastructure improvements
Communication: Fluent in English (C2 level preferred) with the ability to translate technical data concepts into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
Education: Background in Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field



About The Team

You will be working within the Human Resources function – People Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget alignment of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits


Competitive salary and meal allowance
Fair compensation for international work
Health insurance coverage
Remote work permitted within the country
Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad (only applies for Portugal)
Among others



https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
